title: Engineering Sustainable Agents: A Systematic Comparison of Agentic LLMs for Developer Workflows
title_zh: 构建可持续的智能体：面向开发者工作流的智能体式大型语言模型系统性比较

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering, including agentic systems that coordinate multiple agents, but impose higher computational and environmental costs. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of agentic LLM systems across five software engineering tasks: code generation, technical debt identification, code vulnerability detection, log parsing, and log analysis. For each task, we compare LLM configurations that range from a non-agentic single-query baseline to multi-agent workflows, using six open-weight LLMs, two prompt strategies, and three hardware platforms. We assess each configuration in terms of accuracy, inference latency, and energy consumption. Our results reveal substantial trade-offs between agentic complexity and energy efficiency: multi-agent designs consume on average 6.36 × \times as much energy and run 6.07 × \times as long as the non-agentic baseline, with worst-case slowdowns of up to 160 × \times for individual task–hardware pairs. Accuracy gains from additional agents are limited and task-specific: multi-agent improves average vulnerability-detection accuracy, but lightweight non-agentic and single-agent configurations still dominate the Pareto front, accounting for 59 of 66 Pareto-optimal configurations. Model and prompt choice act as task-specific levers whose effective direction varies between tasks rather than as global defaults. We translate these findings into design guidelines for sustainable, task-aware LLM-based development tools.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程领域的应用日益广泛，包括协调多个智能体的智能体系统，但这也带来了更高的计算和环境成本。 在本文中，我们对五个软件工程任务中的智能体 LLM 系统进行了全面的实证研究：代码生成、技术债务识别、代码漏洞检测、日志解析和日志分析。 对于每个任务，我们比较了从非智能体的单查询基线到多智能体工作流的多种 LLM 配置，使用了六个开源权重 LLM、两种提示策略和三种硬件平台。 我们从准确性、推理延迟和能耗三个维度评估了每种配置。 我们的研究结果揭示了智能体复杂性与能源效率之间的显著权衡：多智能体设计的平均能耗是非智能体基线的 6.36 × \times，运行时间也长 6.07 × \times，在某些任务与硬件组合中，最严重的性能下降甚至达到 160 × \times。 增加智能体所带来的准确性提升有限且因任务而异：多智能体设计提高了漏洞检测的平均准确性，但轻量级的非智能体和单智能体配置仍然在帕累托前沿中占据主导地位，占 66 种帕累托最优配置的 59 种。 模型和提示的选择是特定于任务的调节手段，其有效方向因任务而异，而非全局默认设置。 我们将这些发现转化为可持续且具备任务感知能力的 LLM 开发工具的设计指南。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming software engineering by supporting a variety of tasks, including code generation, debugging, code analysis, and documentation ( Ozkaya, 2023 ; He et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2023a ; Widyasari et al., 2025 ; Astekin et al., 2025 ) . These capabilities have been accessed through single-query interactions with general-purpose models. On the other hand, the rise of LLM - based multi - agent systems, where multiple specialized agents collaborate to tackle different parts of a task, promises to enhance reasoning, problem decomposition, and robustness in developer workflows ( He et al., 2025 ) . Early work in this area, such as agent frameworks for secure code generation and multi-agent debate mechanisms, suggests potential benefits including improved code correctness, enhanced security, and better scalability ( Nunez et al., 2024 ; Ishibashi and Nishimura, 2024 ; Chen, 2025 ; Pezzè et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . At the same time, LLMs incur high environmental costs, including substantial energy consumption, water usage, and CO 2 \mathrm{CO_{2}} emissions, with impacts sometimes magnitudes greater for reasoning-intensive prompts compared to simpler ones ( Jegham et al., 2025 ; Husom et al., 2024 ; Samsi et al., 2023 ) . This highlights an urgent need to consider sustainability alongside performance when designing agentic LLM systems.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正在通过支持多种任务彻底改变软件工程，包括代码生成、调试、代码分析和文档编写（Ozkaya, 2023；He et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2023a；Widyasari et al., 2025；Astekin et al., 2025）。 这些能力此前是通过与通用模型进行单次查询交互来实现的。 另一方面，基于LLM的多智能体系统的兴起——其中多个专业智能体协作处理任务的不同部分——有望提升开发者工作流程中的推理能力、问题分解能力和稳健性（He et al., 2025）。 该领域的早期研究，例如用于安全代码生成的智能体框架和多智能体辩论机制，表明其潜在益处包括提高代码正确性、增强安全性以及改善可扩展性（Nunez et al., 2024；Ishibashi and Nishimura, 2024；Chen, 2025；Pezzè et al., 2025；Yu et al., 2025）。 与此同时，LLM会产生高昂的环境成本，包括巨大的能源消耗、用水量和二氧化碳（CO₂）排放，且推理密集型提示对环境的影响有时比简单提示大几个数量级（Jegham et al., 2025；Husom et al., 2024；Samsi et al., 2023）。 这凸显了在设计智能体型LLM系统时，必须将可持续性与性能一并纳入考量的紧迫需求。

paragraphs.en: Problem Statement. Despite the growing enthusiasm for LLM-based multi-agent systems in software engineering, the trade-offs between their effectiveness and sustainability remain under-investigated. Early work has demonstrated that agentic architectures, where autonomous agents orchestrate, refine, and reason collectively, can enhance task performance in domains like code generation and complex problem solving, with success rates increasing by up to 70% compared to single-agent approaches ( Shu et al., 2024 ) . Similarly, literature reviews emphasize the transformative potential of such systems for autonomous software development workflows ( He et al., 2025 ) . However, this enhanced capability often demands greater computational overhead. Previous studies have highlighted that LLM inference consumes substantial energy and contributes notably to CO 2 \mathrm{CO_{2}} emissions , especially for reasoning-intensive prompts ( Cheung et al., 2025 ; Samsi et al., 2023 ; Husom et al., 2024 ; Alizadeh et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 问题陈述。 尽管基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统在软件工程领域日益受到关注，但其有效性与可持续性之间的权衡问题仍研究不足。 早期研究已表明，在自主智能体协同组织、优化和推理的架构中，任务性能可在代码生成和复杂问题解决等领域得到提升，与单智能体方法相比，成功率最高可达 70%（Shu et al., 2024）。 同样，文献综述也强调了此类系统在实现自动化软件开发流程方面的变革潜力（He et al., 2025）。 然而，这种能力的提升通常需要更高的计算开销。 先前的研究指出，大型语言模型的推理过程消耗大量能源，并显著增加二氧化碳（CO₂）排放量，尤其是在处理需要深度推理的提示时（Cheung et al., 2025；Samsi et al., 2023；Husom et al., 2024；Alizadeh et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, no existing study simultaneously evaluates agentic LLM configurations across multiple tasks, models, and hardware platforms with respect to both performance (accuracy, latency) and environmental cost (energy consumption). Without such a multi-dimensional, empirically grounded evaluation, practitioners lack the evidence needed to design effective yet sustainable multi-agent development tools. This gap calls for a structured analysis that bridges performance gains with ecological and practical deployment considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 至关重要的是，目前尚无研究能同时评估智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）配置在多个任务、模型和硬件平台上的性能（准确性、延迟）与环境成本（能源消耗）。 缺乏这种多维度且基于实证的分析，从业者便无法获得设计高效且可持续的多智能体开发工具所需的依据。 这一空白亟需一种结构化分析，以将性能提升与生态影响及实际部署考量相结合。

paragraphs.en: Goal of This Study. The primary goal of this study is to systematically investigate the design, performance, and sustainability trade-offs of multi-agent LLM systems for automating software engineering tasks. Although multi-agent LLM architectures are increasingly studied across diverse domains, systematic empirical evidence on their effectiveness and efficiency in practical developer tasks remains scarce. This study aims to fill this gap by providing empirical evidence and actionable insights across a representative spectrum of software engineering tasks, including code generation , where LLMs are used to synthesize executable source code from natural language prompts; technical debt identification , which involves analyzing code snippets for signs of code smells; code vulnerability detection, which targets identifying security flaws or unsafe coding patterns; log parsing, where structured representations are extracted from raw log files; and log analysis, which involves interpreting parsed logs to detect errors or anomalous system behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的目标。 本研究的主要目标是系统性地探究多智能体 LLM 系统在自动化软件工程任务中的设计、性能与可持续性之间的权衡关系。 尽管多智能体 LLM 架构在各个领域得到了日益广泛的研究，但关于其在实际开发者任务中有效性和效率的系统性实证证据仍然稀缺。 本研究旨在通过在一系列具有代表性的软件工程任务中提供实证证据和可操作的见解来填补这一空白，这些任务包括代码生成（即利用 LLM 根据自然语言提示合成可执行的源代码）、技术债务识别（即分析代码片段以发现代码异味迹象）、代码漏洞检测（即识别安全缺陷或不安全的编码模式）、日志解析（即从原始日志文件中提取结构化表示）以及日志分析（即解释已解析的日志以检测错误或异常的系统行为）。

paragraphs.en: We select these five software engineering tasks because they represent a diverse set of challenges across the software development lifecycle. They vary in terms of input/output structure, reasoning complexity, and reliance on external tools, making them well-suited for evaluating the performance and scalability of different LLM configurations. This diversity enables a comprehensive assessment of how agentic system design impacts effectiveness, efficiency, and sustainability in real-world development scenarios. For each task, we implement a series of increasingly complex LLM-based configurations, i.e., non-agentic single-query models, single-agent setups, dual-agent configurations, and multi-agent workflows involving collective intelligence and division of labor among agents. These configurations are deployed using multiple families of LLMs (i.e., Gemma and its code-specialized variant CodeGemma, Qwen and its code-specialized variant Qwen-Coder, and DeepSeek-Coder) and evaluated on different hardware platforms, including a developer workstation and two high-performance servers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择这五个软件工程任务，因为它们代表了软件开发全生命周期中多样化的一系列挑战。 这些任务在输入/输出结构、推理复杂性和对外部工具的依赖程度方面各不相同，因此非常适合用于评估不同 LLM 配置的性能和可扩展性。 这种多样性使得我们能够全面评估智能体系统的设计如何影响真实世界开发场景中的有效性、效率和可持续性。 对于每个任务，我们都实施了一系列逐步复杂的基于 LLM 的配置，即非智能体的单查询模型、单智能体设置、双智能体配置以及涉及智能体间集体智慧和分工的多智能体工作流程。 这些配置使用多个 LLM 系列（即 Gemma 及其代码专用变体 CodeGemma、Qwen 及其代码专用变体 Qwen-Coder，以及 DeepSeek-Coder）进行部署，并在不同硬件平台上进行评估，包括一台开发者工作站和两台高性能服务器。

sents.en: These configurations are deployed using multiple families of LLMs (i.e., Gemma and its code-specialized variant CodeGemma, Qwen and its code-specialized variant Qwen-Coder, and DeepSeek-Coder) and evaluated on different hardware platforms, including a developer workstation and two high-performance servers.
sents.zh: 这些配置使用多个 LLM 系列（即 Gemma 及其代码专用变体 CodeGemma、Qwen 及其代码专用变体 Qwen-Coder，以及 DeepSeek-Coder）进行部署，并在不同硬件平台上进行评估，包括一台开发者工作站和两台高性能服务器。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to evaluate each system setup along three critical dimensions: accuracy , to measure task-specific effectiveness; inference latency , to understand the responsiveness and feasibility of real-time deployment; and energy consumption , to assess the computational cost of running different configurations. We conduct this study with the expectation that trade-offs will emerge across multiple variation points, including the software engineering task, the underlying LLM model, the agentic system design, and the prompting strategy. This multi-dimensional evaluation enables us to quantify the cost–benefit trade-offs involved in deploying agentic LLM systems for software engineering and to derive generalizable insights into when and how such systems can be used effectively and sustainably.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是沿着三个关键维度评估每种系统配置：准确性，用于衡量特定任务的有效性；推理延迟，用于了解实时部署的响应速度和可行性；以及能源消耗，用于评估运行不同配置的计算成本。 我们开展这项研究，期望在多个变化点之间出现权衡关系，包括软件工程任务、底层的 LLM 模型、智能体系统设计和提示策略。 这种多维度的评估使我们能够量化部署用于软件工程的智能体 LLM 系统所涉及的权衡关系，并得出关于此类系统何时以及如何有效且可持续使用的可推广见解。

paragraphs.en: Research Questions. We structure our study around four research questions (RQs), focusing on the effectiveness, efficiency, and sustainability of LLM-based agentic systems. Specifically, we investigate:
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题。 我们的研究围绕四个研究问题（RQ）展开，重点关注基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统的有效性、效率和可持续性。 具体而言，我们研究：

sents.en: Research Questions.
sents.zh: 研究问题。

sents.en: We structure our study around four research questions (RQs), focusing on the effectiveness, efficiency, and sustainability of LLM-based agentic systems.
sents.zh: 我们的研究围绕四个研究问题（RQ）展开，重点关注基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统的有效性、效率和可持续性。

sents.en: Specifically, we investigate:
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们研究：

paragraphs.en: How do different LLM system configurations perform across software engineering tasks in terms of accuracy? (RQ1)
paragraphs.zh: 不同的 LLM 系统配置在软件工程任务中的准确率表现如何？（研究问题 1）

paragraphs.en: How do LLM system configurations differ in energy consumption across software engineering tasks and hardware platforms? (RQ2)
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型的系统配置在不同软件工程任务和硬件平台上的能耗有何差异？（研究问题2）

paragraphs.en: What is the inference latency of different agent configurations across software engineering tasks and hardware platforms? (RQ3)
paragraphs.zh: 在不同软件工程和硬件平台上，不同智能体配置的推理延迟是多少？（研究问题3）

paragraphs.en: What trade-offs exist between performance, energy efficiency, and latency across software engineering tasks and hardware platforms, and are there task-specific patterns that inform the design of sustainable multi-agent LLM systems? (RQ4)
paragraphs.zh: 在软件工程任务和硬件平台中，性能、能效和延迟之间存在哪些权衡？是否存在特定的任务模式，能够为可持续的多智能体大语言模型系统的设计提供指导？（研究问题4）

paragraphs.en: Our Findings. Our results consistently show that agentic complexity has bounded benefits and systematic costs. The non-agentic baseline (NA) has the highest average accuracy for four of the five tasks, while the multi-agent configuration (MA) performs best for vulnerability detection. Moving from NA to MA increases energy consumption by 6.36 × \times and latency by 6.07 × \times on average, with worst-case slowdowns of up to 160 × \times . Of 66 Pareto-optimal configurations across all tasks, only one is multi-agent, and 36 (55%) are non-agentic. Agentic configuration is therefore a first-order factor, but accuracy gains from additional agents are task-specific while the cost increase is much more systematic. Model and prompt choice, in contrast, have task-specific effects whose direction depends on the task: no single model wins across tasks, and prompt strategy alone can swing log-parsing accuracy from 3.4% to 54.3%. Hardware effects are modest for lightweight workloads but become first-order for heavier configurations, where a high-end server can be 3.4 × \times faster than a workstation on MA. Energy and latency are tightly coupled (Pearson r = 0.987 r=0.987 in log–log space), so optimizing one effectively optimizes the other. Together, these findings indicate that competitive LLM-based developer tools can be built with lightweight, task-aware configurations, and that multi-agent designs should be adopted only with concrete evidence of a task-specific benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的发现。 我们的研究结果一致表明，智能体复杂性带来的收益有限，且存在系统性的成本。 在所有五个任务中，非智能体基线（NA）在四个任务上的平均准确率最高，而多智能体配置（MA）在漏洞检测任务中的表现最佳。 从 NA 切换到 MA 后，平均能源消耗增加了 6.36 × \times，延迟增加了 6.07 × \times，最坏情况下的性能下降幅度高达 160 × \times。 在所有任务中总共存在 66 种帕累托最优配置，其中仅有一种是多智能体配置，而 36 种（占 55%）为非智能体配置。 因此，智能体配置是一个一级因素，但通过增加智能体所带来的准确率提升因任务而异，而成本的增长则更具系统性。 相比之下，模型和提示词的选择对各项任务的影响各不相同，且影响方向取决于具体任务：没有任何单一模型在所有任务中表现最佳，仅靠调整提示词策略就能使日志解析的准确率从 3.4% 提升至 54.3%。 对于轻量级工作负载，硬件带来的影响较为有限；但对于更复杂的配置，硬件则成为一级因素——在多智能体配置（MA）中，高端服务器的速度可比工作站快 3.4 × \times。 能源消耗与延迟紧密相关（在对数-对数空间中，皮尔逊相关系数 r = 0.987），因此优化其中一个指标实际上也能优化另一个。 综合来看，这些发现表明：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的开发者工具可以通过轻量级且具备任务感知能力的配置来构建；而多智能体设计只有在有明确证据表明其能为特定任务带来收益时，才应被采用。

paragraphs.en: Our Contributions. This paper makes the following key contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献。 本文做出了以下关键贡献：

sents.en: Our Contributions.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献。

sents.en: This paper makes the following key contributions:
sents.zh: 本文做出了以下关键贡献：

paragraphs.en: A comprehensive multi-dimensional evaluation of LLM system configurations across diverse software engineering tasks. We design and implement multiple LLM-based system configurations (ranging from non-agentic baselines to complex multi-agent workflows) for five representative software engineering tasks: code generation, technical debt identification, code vulnerability detection, log parsing, and log analysis. This task diversity allows us to assess how configuration complexity impacts effectiveness and efficiency in varied developer contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 对大型语言模型系统配置在不同软件工程任务中的全面多维评估。 我们为五个典型的软件工程任务（代码生成、技术债务识别、代码漏洞检测、日志解析和日志分析）设计和实现了多种基于大型语言模型的系统配置（从非智能体的基线模型到复杂的智能体多工作流）。 这种任务多样性使我们能够评估配置复杂性在不同开发者场景中对有效性和效率的影响。

sents.en: A comprehensive multi-dimensional evaluation of LLM system configurations across diverse software engineering tasks.
sents.zh: 对大型语言模型系统配置在不同软件工程任务中的全面多维评估。

sents.en: We design and implement multiple LLM-based system configurations (ranging from non-agentic baselines to complex multi-agent workflows) for five representative software engineering tasks: code generation, technical debt identification, code vulnerability detection, log parsing, and log analysis.
sents.zh: 我们为五个典型的软件工程任务（代码生成、技术债务识别、代码漏洞检测、日志解析和日志分析）设计和实现了多种基于大型语言模型的系统配置（从非智能体的基线模型到复杂的智能体多工作流）。

sents.en: This task diversity allows us to assess how configuration complexity impacts effectiveness and efficiency in varied developer contexts.
sents.zh: 这种任务多样性使我们能够评估配置复杂性在不同开发者场景中对有效性和效率的影响。

paragraphs.en: A systematic comparison of agentic configurations using different LLMs and hardware platforms. We experiment with a range of instruction-tuned open-weight LLMs spanning multiple model families and sizes, and deploy them across heterogeneous hardware setups (i.e., workstations and servers). This enables us to investigate how model characteristics and deployment environments influence task performance and resource usage.
paragraphs.zh: 对使用不同大型语言模型和硬件平台的智能体配置进行系统性比较。 我们试验了多种经过指令微调的开放权重大型语言模型，涵盖多个模型系列和规模，并将其部署在异构硬件环境（即工作站和服务器）中。 这使得我们能够研究模型特性与部署环境如何影响任务表现和资源使用。

sents.en: A systematic comparison of agentic configurations using different LLMs and hardware platforms.
sents.zh: 对使用不同大型语言模型和硬件平台的智能体配置进行系统性比较。

sents.en: We experiment with a range of instruction-tuned open-weight LLMs spanning multiple model families and sizes, and deploy them across heterogeneous hardware setups (i.e., workstations and servers).
sents.zh: 我们试验了多种经过指令微调的开放权重大型语言模型，涵盖多个模型系列和规模，并将其部署在异构硬件环境（即工作站和服务器）中。

sents.en: This enables us to investigate how model characteristics and deployment environments influence task performance and resource usage.
sents.zh: 这使得我们能够研究模型特性与部署环境如何影响任务表现和资源使用。

paragraphs.en: A detailed empirical analysis of trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and energy consumption. We measure each configuration’s performance using a unified evaluation framework that captures inference latency and energy use. Our results reveal how agentic complexity, model size, prompting strategies, and hardware choice interact to affect performance and sustainability outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 对准确性、延迟和能耗之间权衡关系的详细实证分析。 我们使用一个统一的评估框架来衡量每种配置的性能，该框架能够捕捉推理延迟和能源消耗情况。 我们的研究结果揭示了智能体复杂性、模型规模、提示策略以及硬件选择如何相互作用，从而影响性能与可持续性成果。

sents.en: A detailed empirical analysis of trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and energy consumption.
sents.zh: 对准确性、延迟和能耗之间权衡关系的详细实证分析。

sents.en: We measure each configuration’s performance using a unified evaluation framework that captures inference latency and energy use.
sents.zh: 我们使用一个统一的评估框架来衡量每种配置的性能，该框架能够捕捉推理延迟和能源消耗情况。

sents.en: Our results reveal how agentic complexity, model size, prompting strategies, and hardware choice interact to affect performance and sustainability outcomes.
sents.zh: 我们的研究结果揭示了智能体复杂性、模型规模、提示策略以及硬件选择如何相互作用，从而影响性能与可持续性成果。

paragraphs.en: Identification of task-specific and generalizable patterns across agentic design choices. By comparing configurations across tasks, we uncover when lightweight agentic setups (e.g., single or dual agents) suffice and when more complex multi-agent workflows yield measurable benefits. We highlight configurations that offer favorable trade-offs, enabling developers to make informed design decisions based on their constraints and priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 识别智能体设计选择中特定于任务且可泛化的模式。 通过跨任务比较不同配置，我们揭示了何时轻量级的智能体设置（例如单个或双智能体）已足够，以及何时更复杂的多人智能体工作流程能带来可量化的益处。 我们重点介绍了能够提供良好权衡的配置，使开发者能够根据自身的限制和优先事项做出明智的设计决策。

sents.en: Identification of task-specific and generalizable patterns across agentic design choices.
sents.zh: 识别智能体设计选择中特定于任务且可泛化的模式。

sents.en: By comparing configurations across tasks, we uncover when lightweight agentic setups (e.g., single or dual agents) suffice and when more complex multi-agent workflows yield measurable benefits.
sents.zh: 通过跨任务比较不同配置，我们揭示了何时轻量级的智能体设置（例如单个或双智能体）已足够，以及何时更复杂的多人智能体工作流程能带来可量化的益处。

sents.en: We highlight configurations that offer favorable trade-offs, enabling developers to make informed design decisions based on their constraints and priorities.
sents.zh: 我们重点介绍了能够提供良好权衡的配置，使开发者能够根据自身的限制和优先事项做出明智的设计决策。

paragraphs.en: Design guidelines for sustainable and effective LLM-based developer tools. Drawing from our findings, we distill a set of practical recommendations for building energy-efficient, task-aware, and scalable agentic LLM systems. These guidelines are intended to inform the future development of intelligent assistants, autonomous developer agents, and AI-augmented software engineering platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 可持续且高效的基于大型语言模型的开发者工具设计指南。 基于我们的研究结果，我们提炼出了一系列实用建议，用于构建节能、任务感知且可扩展的智能体式大型语言模型系统。 这些指南旨在为未来智能助手、自主开发者智能体以及人工智能增强型软件工程平台的发展提供指导。

sents.en: Design guidelines for sustainable and effective LLM-based developer tools.
sents.zh: 可持续且高效的基于大型语言模型的开发者工具设计指南。

sents.en: Drawing from our findings, we distill a set of practical recommendations for building energy-efficient, task-aware, and scalable agentic LLM systems.
sents.zh: 基于我们的研究结果，我们提炼出了一系列实用建议，用于构建节能、任务感知且可扩展的智能体式大型语言模型系统。

sents.en: These guidelines are intended to inform the future development of intelligent assistants, autonomous developer agents, and AI-augmented software engineering platforms.
sents.zh: 这些指南旨在为未来智能助手、自主开发者智能体以及人工智能增强型软件工程平台的发展提供指导。

paragraphs.en: Collectively, these contributions provide a comprehensive view of the effectiveness, efficiency, and sustainability of agentic LLM systems, offering guidance for their practical design and deployment in software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些成果全面展示了智能体式大语言模型系统在有效性、效率和可持续性方面的表现，为它们在软件工程领域的实际设计与部署提供了指导。

paragraphs.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. In Section 2 , we summarize the background on LLMs and energy monitoring. Section 3 presents our experimental setup, results, and analysis. In Section 4 , we summarize our findings for each research question. Section 5 synthesizes these findings across RQs and distils design guidelines for sustainable agentic LLM systems. Section 6 presents threats to the validity of our experiments. Finally, Section 7 concludes the paper and outlines directions for future research.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are an emerging paradigm for enabling collaboration, specialization, and iterative reasoning across autonomous agents. In contrast to single-turn, single-agent interactions, multi-agent LLM systems leverage structured communication and role decomposition to handle complex tasks more effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）是一种新兴范式，能够促进自主智能体之间的协作、专业化与迭代推理。 与单轮次、单智能体的交互不同，多智能体 LLM 系统通过结构化通信和角色分解，能更有效地处理复杂任务。

sents.en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are an emerging paradigm for enabling collaboration, specialization, and iterative reasoning across autonomous agents.

sents.en: In contrast to single-turn, single-agent interactions, multi-agent LLM systems leverage structured communication and role decomposition to handle complex tasks more effectively.

paragraphs.en: Recent surveys and systematizations outline the architectural components of LLM-based multi-agent systems, including agent roles, memory, planning, and interaction protocols. Li et al. ( Li et al., 2024b ) provide a comprehensive taxonomy of multi-agent LLM capabilities, highlighting key challenges in scalability, coordination, and self-evolution. Similarly, Tran et al. ( Tran et al., 2025 ) and Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2025 ) survey coordination strategies in multi-agent LLMs, offering categorizations of mechanisms and patterns that frame the design space of such systems.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的综述和系统化研究概述了基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统的架构组件，包括智能体的角色、记忆、规划和交互协议。Li 等人 （Li 等人，2024b）对多智能体大型语言模型的能力提供了全面的分类，重点指出了可扩展性、协调性和自我演化方面的关键挑战。同样地，Tran 等人 （Tran 等人，2025）和 Liu 等人 （Liu 等人，2025）综述了多智能体大型语言模型中的协调策略，对机制和模式进行了分类，从而界定了此类系统的设计空间。

paragraphs.en: Several open-source agent frameworks have been developed to support these patterns. They provide infrastructure for task orchestration, agent communication, and integration with external tools or data sources. Examples include AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , which enables multi-agent collaboration for solving complex tasks, and Semantic Kernel ( Semantic Kernel, 2024 ) , which combines LLMs with modular plugins for scalable AI systems. AutoGPT ( AutoGPT, 2024 ) supports autonomous multi-step task execution through planning and refinement. Similarly, OpenAgents ( Xie et al., 2023 ) and AgentGPT ( AgentGPT, 2024 ) focus on deploying autonomous AI agents, emphasizing modularity, integration, and usability for real-world applications. These frameworks excel in enabling multi-agent collaboration, where specialized agents—such as those for code generation, result interpretation, or output refinement—work together to achieve shared objectives. Frameworks like AutoGen and AutoGPT decompose complex workflows into manageable tasks, enhancing the efficiency and flexibility of LLM-powered systems. Interoperability is another critical feature, allowing seamless integration with external databases, APIs, and knowledge graphs. Tools like OpenAgents , AgentGPT , and Semantic Kernel streamline the processing of heterogeneous data, aligning real-time and historical information with system-specific knowledge to generate actionable insights.
paragraphs.zh: 已有多个开源智能体框架被开发出来，以支持这些模式。 它们为任务编排、智能体通信以及与外部工具或数据源的集成提供了基础设施。 例如 AutoGen（Wu 等，2023），它支持多智能体协作以解决复杂任务；以及 Semantic Kernel（Semantic Kernel，2024），它将 LLM 与模块化插件相结合，构建可扩展的人工智能系统。 AutoGPT（AutoGPT，2024）通过规划与优化，支持自主的多步骤任务执行。 类似地，OpenAgents（Xie 等，2023）和 AgentGPT（AgentGPT，2024）专注于部署自主人工智能智能体，强调模块化、集成性和在现实应用中的易用性。 这些框架在多智能体协作方面表现突出：专业智能体——例如负责代码生成、结果解释或输出优化的智能体——协同工作以实现共同目标。 AutoGen 和 AutoGPT 等框架将复杂的工作流分解为可管理的任务，从而提升了基于 LLM 的系统效率和灵活性。 互操作性是另一项关键特性，它实现了与外部数据库、API 和知识图谱的无缝集成。 OpenAgents、AgentGPT 和 Semantic Kernel 等工具简化了异构数据的处理流程，将实时信息与历史信息同系统特定知识对齐，以生成可操作的洞察。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent LLM systems represent a significant evolution in AI-assisted software engineering, offering new capabilities for structured collaboration and task specialization. While frameworks such as AutoGen, OpenAgents, and AgentGPT provide a foundation for their development, rigorous empirical evaluation, particularly with respect to performance-efficiency trade-offs and environmental impact, is still lacking. This paper contributes to filling that gap by systematically assessing multi-agent configurations across software engineering tasks, models, and hardware platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体大语言模型系统代表了人工智能辅助软件工程领域的一次重大演进，为结构化协作和任务专业化带来了新的能力。 尽管 AutoGen、OpenAgents 和 AgentGPT 等框架为其开发提供了基础，但严格的实证评估——尤其是关于性能与效率的权衡以及环境影响方面的评估——仍然不足。 本文通过系统性地评估多智能体配置在不同软件工程任务、模型和硬件平台上的表现，为填补这一空白做出了贡献。

paragraphs.en: Recent advancements in LLM-based MAS have sparked considerable interest in the software engineering community, owing to their enhanced problem-solving capabilities and structured collaboration patterns ( He et al., 2025 ) . For instance, multi-agent frameworks built on LLMs have significantly advanced the field of automated code generation ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ) . These approaches decompose the complex process of software synthesis into specialized sub-tasks, such as planning, coding, testing, and debugging, handled by collaborating agents, thereby addressing limitations in coherence, correctness, and scalability inherent to single-agent LLM systems. AgentCoder by Huang et al. ( Huang et al., 2023 ) exemplifies this architecture with a system comprising programmer, test designer, and test executor agents. These agents iteratively generate, test, and refine code, resulting in performance gains on HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks over state-of-the-art single-agent models. Similarly, CodeTree ( Li et al., 2024a ) introduces a tree-search-based planning strategy for LLM agents, which guides decision-making across code generation stages via both environment feedback and LLM-generated reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）的最新进展，因其增强的问题解决能力和结构化的协作模式，在软件工程领域引起了广泛关注（He 等人，2025）。 例如，基于大型语言模型的多智能体框架已显著推动了自动化代码生成领域的进步（Jiang 等人，2024；He 等人，2025）。 这些方法将复杂的软件合成过程分解为专门的子任务，如规划、编码、测试和调试，由协作的智能体分别处理，从而解决了单智能体大型语言模型系统在连贯性、正确性和可扩展性方面的固有局限性。 Huang 等人提出的 AgentCoder （Huang 等人，2023）通过一个包含程序员、测试设计者和测试执行者智能体的系统，展示了这种架构。 这些智能体迭代地生成、测试和优化代码，在 HumanEval 和 MBPP 基准测试中的表现优于当前最先进的单智能体模型。 类似地，CodeTree（Li 等人，2024a）为大型语言模型智能体引入了一种基于树搜索的规划策略，该策略通过环境反馈和大型语言模型生成的推理，指导代码生成各阶段的决策过程。

paragraphs.en: Another approach, CodeCoR, integrates self-reflective evaluation into the multi-agent code pipeline, combining prompt design, test generation, repair, and re-coding steps to ensure robustness and quality of results ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . These frameworks often feature feedback loops where code is revised based on syntactic or semantic failures, a technique that has also been extended to security-enhanced frameworks such as AutoSafeCoder, which includes fuzz testing and static analysis agents to enforce safety constraints ( Nunez et al., 2024 ) . INTERVENOR ( Wang et al., 2023 ) employs a collaborative agent architecture consisting of a Code Learner and a Code Teacher. The Code Learner is responsible for generating an initial code implementation and compiling it to assess correctness. Upon detecting errors, the Code Teacher analyzes both the faulty code and the resulting error reports, then provides targeted repair instructions to guide the refinement of the solution. Self-repair ( Olausson et al., 2023 ) and TGen ( Mathews and Nagappan, 2024 ) improve code quality by leveraging feedback from the execution of predefined test cases to iteratively refine and correct generated programs. MAGIS ( Tao et al., 2024 ) introduces a four-agent system (Manager, Custodian, Developer, and QA) that cooperatively resolves GitHub issues, achieving up to an eightfold increase in resolution rates compared to GPT-4 alone. AgentMesh ( Khanzadeh, 2025 ) structures agents into Planner, Coder, Debugger, and Reviewer roles that sequentially transform high-level requirements into tested, validated code, a practical orchestration of developer workflows. Self - Organized Agents ( Ishibashi and Nishimura, 2024 ) propose a dynamically scaled agent group to collaboratively generate and optimize ultra-large codebases. Their framework surpasses single-agent baselines by 5% in pass@1 accuracy (i.e., the statistical probability that a single, independent generation attempt by an AI model correctly solves a given problem) on HumanEval through distributed, component-wise code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法 CodeCoR 将自我反思式评估整合到多智能体代码流程中，结合提示设计、测试生成、修复和重新编码步骤，以确保结果的稳健性和质量（Pan 等人，2025）。 这些框架通常包含反馈循环，代码会根据语法或语义错误进行修订；这一技术也已被扩展到安全增强型框架中，例如 AutoSafeCoder，它通过引入模糊测试和静态分析智能体来强制执行安全约束（Nunez 等人，2024）。 INTERVENOR（Wang 等人，2023）采用了一种协作式智能体架构，由代码学习者和代码教师组成。 代码学习者负责生成初始的代码实现并进行编译，以评估其正确性。 在检测到错误后，代码教师会分析有问题的代码和由此产生的错误报告，然后提供有针对性的修复指令，以指导解决方案的优化。 Self-repair（Olausson 等人，2023）和 TGen（Mathews 和 Nagappan，2024）通过利用预定义测试用例执行过程中的反馈，迭代地优化和修正生成的程序，从而提升代码质量。 MAGIS（Tao 等人，2024）引入了一套由四个智能体（管理器、维护者、开发者和 QA）组成的系统，用于协作解决 GitHub 问题，其问题解决率相比单独使用 GPT-4 最高提升了八倍。 AgentMesh（Khanzadeh，2025）将智能体划分为规划者、编码者、调试者和评审者等角色，这些角色按顺序将高级需求转化为经过测试和验证的代码，实现了开发者工作流的实用化编排。 自组织智能体（Ishibashi 和 Nishimura，2024）提出了一种可动态扩展的智能体群体，用于协作生成和优化超大型代码库。 在 HumanEval 数据集上，通过分布式、按组件生成代码的方式，他们的框架在 pass@1 准确率（即 AI 模型单次独立生成尝试正确解决给定问题的统计概率）上比单智能体基线模型高出 5%。

paragraphs.en: While promising for software engineering tasks, multi-agent LLM systems also introduce new challenges in orchestration overhead, prompt alignment, tool integration, and reproducibility. Moreover, the environmental cost of multi-agent coordination remains largely unexplored. Increased agent interactions and tool calls often translate into higher inference latency and energy usage, raising important concerns around sustainability that existing frameworks do not address explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管多智能体大语言模型系统在软件工程任务中展现出巨大潜力，但它们也带来了协调开销、提示对齐、工具集成和可重复性方面的新挑战。 此外，多智能体协作的环境成本在很大程度上仍未被探索。 智能体交互和工具调用的增加通常会导致推理延迟和能源消耗上升，从而引发了现有框架并未明确处理的可持续性相关重要问题。

paragraphs.en: The environmental footprint of modern AI has become a central research concern. Early landmark analyses quantified the energy and carbon costs of training large NLP models and called for standardized reporting practices ( Strubell et al., 2019 ; Henderson et al., 2020 ) . In parallel, the Green AI perspective argued for evaluating models not only by accuracy but also by efficiency metrics such as energy, emissions, and compute, to counter the escalating resource demands of state-of-the-art systems ( Schwartz et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent systems-level work showed that lifecycle emissions depend strongly on model size, training/inference efficiency, datacenter efficiency (PUE), and the carbon intensity of the electricity mix, highlighting that location and infrastructure choices can change emissions by orders of magnitude ( Patterson et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现代人工智能的环境足迹已成为一项核心的研究议题。 早期的里程碑式分析量化了训练大型自然语言处理模型所需的能源和碳成本，并呼吁建立标准化的报告实践（Strubell 等，2019；Henderson 等，2020）。 与此同时，“绿色人工智能”的观点主张，除了准确性之外，还应通过效率指标（如能源消耗、排放量和计算量）来评估模型，以应对顶尖系统日益增长的资源需求（Schwartz 等，2020）。 后续的系统级研究表明，全生命周期排放强烈依赖于模型规模、训练/推理效率、数据中心的能效（PUE）以及电力组合的碳强度，这凸显了选址和基础设施的选择可使排放量产生数量级的差异（Patterson 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Beyond training, inference is now a dominant and fast-growing driver of AI’s footprint due to widespread deployment of LLMs. Studies emphasize that prompt length, decoding strategy, and multi-turn/agentic interaction patterns materially increase energy use and latency, raising the need for efficiency-aware evaluation and reporting during inference as well as training ( Cheung et al., 2025 ; Samsi et al., 2023 ; Husom et al., 2024 ; Alizadeh et al., 2025 ; Henderson et al., 2020 ; Patterson et al., 2024 ; Husom et al., 2025 ) . Tooling has emerged to help practitioners measure and report runtime impacts, e.g., CarbonTracker ( Anthony et al., 2020 ) for training runs and epoch-level estimates, MLCO2/CodeCarbon-style approaches ( Lacoste et al., 2019 ) for standardized emissions estimation from energy data and regional grids, and MELODI ( Husom et al., 2024 ) specialized for measuring energy consumption of LLM inference.
paragraphs.zh: 除了训练之外，由于大型语言模型（LLM）的广泛部署，推理如今已成为人工智能碳足迹的主要且快速增长的驱动因素。 多项研究强调，提示词长度、解码策略以及多轮/智能体交互模式会显著增加能源消耗和延迟，因此无论是在推理还是训练阶段，都需要开展关注效率的评估与报告（Cheung et al., 2025；Samsi et al., 2023；Husom et al., 2024；Alizadeh et al., 2025；Henderson et al., 2020；Patterson et al., 2024；Husom et al., 2025）。 目前已出现多种工具，帮助从业者测量和报告运行时影响，例如：用于训练运行和单轮次估算的 CarbonTracker（Anthony et al., 2020）；基于能源数据和区域电网进行标准化排放估算的 MLCO2/CodeCarbon 类方法（Lacoste et al., 2019）；以及专门用于测量 LLM 推理能耗的 MELODI（Husom et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work targets algorithmic and systems optimizations to reduce inference cost: low-bit quantization and efficient kernels (e.g., GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2022 ) and LLM.int8 ( Dettmers et al., 2022 ) ), context and routing strategies that avoid unnecessary large-model calls (e.g., FrugalGPT ( Chen et al., 2023 ) ), and faster decoding methods such as speculative decoding and multi-draft generation that cut token-generation latency and compute ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ) . Hardware-aware inference optimizations—including fused, I/O-aware attention kernels, paged KV-cache management, and KV-cache compression or eviction—reduce memory traffic and improve inference throughput on GPUs ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023b ) . However, their energy benefits depend strongly on the workload, software stack, and accelerator architecture ( Fernandez et al., 2025 ) . Hardware–software co-design for edge inference can further improve energy efficiency, reinforcing the need to jointly tune models, workloads, runtimes, and hardware for sustainable deployment ( Huang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 另一项互补的研究方向则聚焦于算法和系统优化，以降低推理成本：包括低比特量化和高效内核（例如 GPTQ（Frantar 等人，2022）和 LLM.int8（Dettmers 等人，2022））、避免不必要的大模型调用的上下文与路由策略（例如 FrugalGPT（Chen 等人，2023）），以及更快的解码方法，如推测性解码和多草稿生成，这些方法能够缩短令牌生成的延迟并减少计算量（Leviathan 等人，2023；He 等人，2023）。 面向硬件的推理优化——包括融合型、考虑 I/O 的注意力内核、分页 KV 缓存管理以及 KV 缓存压缩或淘汰——能够减少内存流量，并提升 GPU 上的推理吞吐量（Dao 等人，2022；Kwon 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2023b）。 然而，这些方法在能源效率方面的收益高度依赖于工作负载、软件栈和加速器架构（Fernandez 等人，2025）。 面向边缘推理的硬件-软件协同设计可以进一步提升能源效率，这也凸显了为实现可持续部署而联合优化模型、工作负载、运行时和硬件的必要性（Huang 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Finally, sustainability extends beyond carbon and electricity. Resource accounting frameworks increasingly include water footprint and thermal constraints for datacenters, with evidence that large-scale LLM training and inference can incur substantial hidden water usage depending on cooling strategies and geography ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Together, these strands motivate rigorous, multi-objective evaluation for accuracy and efficiency (energy, CO 2 \mathrm{CO_{2}} , latency), and transparent reporting standards, especially for agentic LLM workflows where longer contexts and multi-turn exchanges can amplify resource consumption.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，可持续性不仅限于碳和电力。 资源核算框架越来越多地纳入了数据中心的用水足迹和热约束条件，有证据表明，大规模 LLM 训练和推理可能会产生巨大的隐藏用水量，具体取决于冷却策略和地理位置（Li et al., 2025）。 综合来看，这些方面共同推动了针对准确性和效率（能源、CO₂\mathrm{CO_{2}}、延迟）的严格多目标评估，以及透明的报告标准，尤其是对于智能体式 LLM 工作流程而言，因为更长的上下文和多轮交互可能会放大资源消耗。

paragraphs.en: While the prior sections document advances in multi-agent LLM systems within software engineering and the growing attention to environmental implications of AI, three major gaps remain:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管前面的章节记录了多智能体大型语言模型系统在软件工程领域的进步，以及人们对人工智能环境影响的日益关注，但仍然存在三个主要空白：

paragraphs.en: Lack of Comprehensive Empirical Evaluations Across Agentic Configurations. Most existing studies primarily evaluate their systems on isolated tasks (e.g., code generation or issue resolution), often comparing single-agent baselines to a single agentic design ( He et al., 2025 ) . However, there is a lack of systematic empirical work that evaluates multiple agentic configurations (e.g., non-agentic, single-agent, dual-agent, multi-agent workflows) across a diverse set of software engineering tasks. This makes it difficult to generalize findings across development activities in the software lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 缺乏跨智能体配置的全面实证评估。 大多数现有研究主要在其孤立任务（例如代码生成或问题解决）上评估其系统，通常将单一智能体基线方法与单一的智能体设计进行比较（He et al., 2025）。 然而，目前缺乏系统的实证研究来评估多种智能体配置（例如非智能体、单一智能体、双智能体和多智能体工作流程）在多样化软件工程任务中的表现。 这使得难以将研究结果推广到软件生命周期中的各种开发活动。

sents.en: Lack of Comprehensive Empirical Evaluations Across Agentic Configurations.
sents.zh: 缺乏跨智能体配置的全面实证评估。

sents.zh: 然而，目前缺乏系统的实证研究来评估多种智能体配置（例如非智能体、单一智能体、双智能体和多智能体工作流程）在多样化软件工程任务中的表现。

sents.zh: 这使得难以将研究结果推广到软件生命周期中的各种开发活动。

paragraphs.en: Missing Joint Evaluation of Sustainability and Performance Metrics. The growing corpus on Green AI and AI’s environmental impact emphasizes energy and CO 2 \mathrm{CO_{2}} metrics alongside accuracy (e.g., ( Strubell et al., 2019 ; Henderson et al., 2020 ; Schwartz et al., 2020 ; Patterson et al., 2024 ; Cheung et al., 2025 ; Samsi et al., 2023 ; Husom et al., 2024 ) ). However, no prior work in SE-focused multi-agent LLM systems has simultaneously measured accuracy, inference latency, energy consumption, and estimated carbon emissions for different architectural configurations. This omission hinders our ability to understand the trade-offs between performance and sustainability when deploying agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 可持续性与性能指标联合评估的缺失。 关于绿色人工智能及其环境影响的研究文献日益丰富，这些研究在强调准确性的同时，也关注能源和二氧化碳（CO₂）指标（例如：(Strubell et al., 2019; Henderson et al., 2020; Schwartz et al., 2020; Patterson et al., 2024; Cheung et al., 2025; Samsi et al., 2023; Husom et al., 2024)）。 然而，在专注于软件工程的智能体大语言模型系统中，尚无先前的工作能够同时测量不同架构配置下的准确性、推理延迟、能源消耗和估算的碳排放量。 这种缺失阻碍了我们理解部署智能体系统时性能与可持续性之间的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: Reevaluating the Need for Agentic Complexity. Recent work such as that by Xia et al. ( Xia et al., 2025 ) questions whether elaborate agent architectures are always necessary. The authors show that a simpler, non-agentic three-phase approach (localization, repair, patch validation) can outperform complex agents in both performance and cost metrics on SWE - bench Lite benchmarks. This suggests that agentic workflows may not always be the most efficient solution, and emphasizes the need for systematic comparison across configurations with sustainability in mind.
paragraphs.zh: 重新评估智能体复杂性的必要性。 近期的研究，例如 Xia 等人的研究， （Xia 等人，2025）质疑复杂的智能体架构是否总是必要的。 作者表明，一种更简单、非智能体的三阶段方法（定位、修复、补丁验证）在 SWE-bench Lite 基准测试中，无论是在性能还是成本指标上，都能超越复杂的智能体。 这表明，智能体工作流程可能并非始终是最高效的解决方案，并强调了在考虑可持续性的前提下，对不同配置进行系统性比较的必要性。

paragraphs.en: By explicitly addressing these gaps (multi-configuration comparison across tasks, integrated performance-sustainability measurement, and validation of agent simplicity), our study fills a critical void in both the SE and AI sustainability literature.
paragraphs.zh: 通过明确解决这些空白（跨任务的多种配置比较、性能与可持续性的综合测量，以及对智能体简洁性的验证），我们的研究填补了软件工程和人工智能可持续性文献中的一个关键空白。

paragraphs.en: We investigate the following Research Questions (RQs) across five software engineering tasks using four datasets, where two of the tasks (log parsing and log analysis) are performed on a shared dataset (HDFS logs).
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对五个软件工程任务，使用四个数据集对以下研究问题（RQs）进行了探究，其中两个任务（日志解析和日志分析）是在一个共享数据集（HDFS 日志）上执行的。

paragraphs.en: RQ1. How do different LLM system configurations perform across software engineering tasks in terms of accuracy? This question aims to assess the effectiveness of each configuration, ranging from non-agentic to complex multi-agent workflows, in achieving accurate task completion across various software engineering scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1. 不同的 LLM 系统配置在软件工程任务中的准确率表现如何？ 该问题旨在评估每种配置（从非智能体模式到复杂的多智能体工作流程）在各种软件工程场景中实现准确任务完成的有效性。

What trade-offs exist between performance (accuracy), energy efficiency, and latency across software engineering tasks and hardware platforms, and are there task-specific patterns that inform the design of sustainable multi-agent LLM systems? paragraphs.en: We used HumanEval , a benchmark introduced by Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2021 ) for evaluating functional correctness in code generation with LLMs. The dataset consists of 164 handwritten Python programming problems, each including a function signature, natural language docstring, reference implementation, and several unit tests (on average 7.7 tests per problem) 1 1 1 https://github.com/openai/human-eval . The problems are deliberately hand-written to avoid contamination from public sources such as GitHub repositories. HumanEval tasks cover language comprehension, reasoning, algorithmic design, and simple mathematics, making it a diverse and challenging benchmark that has been widely adopted for evaluating LLM-based code generation systems ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Ishibashi and Nishimura, 2024 ; Li et al., 2024a )
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了由 Chen 等人引入的基准数据集 HumanEval。 （Chen 等人，2021）用于评估大型语言模型在代码生成中的功能正确性。 该数据集包含 164 个手写 Python 编程问题，每个问题都包括一个函数签名、自然语言文档字符串、参考实现以及若干单元测试（平均每个问题 7.7 个测试）1 1 1 https://github.com/openai/human-eval。 这些问题是特意手写的，以避免受到 GitHub 仓库等公开来源的污染。 HumanEval 任务涵盖了语言理解、推理、算法设计和基础数学，使其成为一个多样化且富有挑战性的基准数据集，已被广泛用于评估基于大型语言模型的代码生成系统（Huang 等人，2023；Ishibashi 和 Nishimura，2024；Li 等人，2024a）。

paragraphs.en: We used an industry-relevant code smell dataset called MLCQ (Madeyski Lewowski Code Quest) ( Madeyski and Lewowski, 2020 ) . It contains nearly 15,000 code snippets in Java. Each snippet was independently reviewed by experts who were asked to indicate the presence or absence of a specific smell type. Two of these smell types are function-level ( Long Method , Feature Envy ). The other two are class-level ( Blob , Data Class ). Every code snippet that is checked for one of these smell types is labeled with one of the severity levels: None , Minor , Major , Critical . A single code snippet could be checked for multiple smells by the same or different experts. We analyzed recurring code snippets across different samples to consolidate a dataset for our evaluation. For the same code snippet with multiple reviews at either the function or class level:
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了一个与行业相关的代码异味数据集，名为 MLCQ（Madeyski Lewowski Code Quest）（Madeyski 和 Lewowski，2020）。 该数据集包含近 15,000 个 Java 语言代码片段。 每个代码片段都由专家独立评审，专家们被要求指出是否存在某种特定的异味类型。 其中两种异味类型属于函数级（长方法、功能窥探）。 另外两种则属于类级（臃肿类、数据类）。 每个针对这些异味类型之一进行检查的代码片段，都会被标注一个严重程度等级：无、轻微、严重或关键。 同一个代码片段可能由相同或不同的专家检查出多种异味。 我们分析了不同样本中重复出现的代码片段，以整合用于评估的数据集。 对于在函数级或类级存在多次评审的同一代码片段：

sents.en: We used an industry-relevant code smell dataset called MLCQ (Madeyski Lewowski Code Quest) ( Madeyski and Lewowski, 2020 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用了一个与行业相关的代码异味数据集，名为 MLCQ（Madeyski Lewowski Code Quest）（Madeyski 和 Lewowski，2020）。

sents.en: It contains nearly 15,000 code snippets in Java.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含近 15,000 个 Java 语言代码片段。

sents.en: Each snippet was independently reviewed by experts who were asked to indicate the presence or absence of a specific smell type.
sents.zh: 每个代码片段都由专家独立评审，专家们被要求指出是否存在某种特定的异味类型。

sents.en: Two of these smell types are function-level ( Long Method , Feature Envy ).
sents.zh: 其中两种异味类型属于函数级（长方法、功能窥探）。

sents.en: The other two are class-level ( Blob , Data Class ).
sents.zh: 另外两种则属于类级（臃肿类、数据类）。

sents.en: Every code snippet that is checked for one of these smell types is labeled with one of the severity levels: None , Minor , Major , Critical .
sents.zh: 每个针对这些异味类型之一进行检查的代码片段，都会被标注一个严重程度等级：无、轻微、严重或关键。

sents.en: A single code snippet could be checked for multiple smells by the same or different experts.
sents.zh: 同一个代码片段可能由相同或不同的专家检查出多种异味。

sents.en: We analyzed recurring code snippets across different samples to consolidate a dataset for our evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们分析了不同样本中重复出现的代码片段，以整合用于评估的数据集。

sents.en: For the same code snippet with multiple reviews at either the function or class level:
sents.zh: 对于在函数级或类级存在多次评审的同一代码片段：

paragraphs.en: If all reviews label the snippet with severity None , we also assign it the None label, indicating that it is not associated with any smell.
paragraphs.zh: 如果所有评论都将该片段标记为严重程度 None，我们也会将其分配为 None 标签，表示它与任何异味无关。

paragraphs.en: If multiple smells are reported with severity other than None , we exclude the snippet to avoid ambiguity, since the assigned task is to identify whether any smell was present and, if so, which one.
paragraphs.zh: 如果报告了多个严重程度非 None 的异味，我们将排除该代码片段以避免歧义，因为分配的任务是确定是否存在任何异味，以及如果存在，具体是哪种异味。

paragraphs.en: If the severity for one review is None and it is Major or Critical for the other type of smell at the corresponding level, we assign its label for the associated smell. For example, if the review for Long Method indicates severity None , but the review for Feature Envy indicates severity Critical , then we assign the label Feature Envy with severity Critical to that code snippet.
paragraphs.zh: 如果其中一个审查的严重程度为 None，而另一个对应级别的代码异味类型是 Major 或 Critical，那么我们就为该相关代码异味分配其标签。 例如，如果 Long Method 的审查显示严重程度为 None，但 Feature Envy 的审查显示严重程度为 Critical，那么我们就将该代码片段标记为 Feature Envy，并赋予其 Critical 的严重程度。

sents.en: If the severity for one review is None and it is Major or Critical for the other type of smell at the corresponding level, we assign its label for the associated smell.
sents.zh: 如果其中一个审查的严重程度为 None，而另一个对应级别的代码异味类型是 Major 或 Critical，那么我们就为该相关代码异味分配其标签。

sents.en: For example, if the review for Long Method indicates severity None , but the review for Feature Envy indicates severity Critical , then we assign the label Feature Envy with severity Critical to that code snippet.
sents.zh: 例如，如果 Long Method 的审查显示严重程度为 None，但 Feature Envy 的审查显示严重程度为 Critical，那么我们就将该代码片段标记为 Feature Envy，并赋予其 Critical 的严重程度。

paragraphs.en: We discarded entries labeled with Minor severity, as well as those containing code snippets from inaccessible repositories, missing files, or outdated or hidden content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们丢弃了标记为“次要严重性”的条目，以及包含来自无法访问的仓库的代码片段、缺失文件或过时或隐藏内容的条目。

paragraphs.en: As a result, we obtained a dataset with 6,441 samples without repeated entries (reviews) for any code snippet associated with one of the various types of smells. However, this dataset was still subject to code snippets that are possibly associated with multiple smell types at the same time. Reviewers assessing class-level code smells focused solely on class-level smell types ( Madeyski and Lewowski, 2020 ) . However, function-level smells can also exist within these classes. To avoid ambiguity and ensure that each code snippet is associated with a single smell type, we manually checked all the class-level code snippets. If a class-level code snippet contained a function-level smell, we excluded it from the dataset. For our evaluation, we selected a reduced sample of 385 code snippets as summarized in Table 2 . These samples are randomly shuffled.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们得到了一个包含 6,441 个样本的数据集，其中与各种气味类型相关的任何代码片段都没有重复的条目（评论）。 然而，该数据集仍然可能包含同时与多种气味类型相关的代码片段。 评估类级别代码气味的评审者仅关注类级别的气味类型（Madeyski 和 Lewowski，2020）。 然而，函数级别的气味也可能存在于这些类中。 为避免歧义并确保每个代码片段仅与单一气味类型相关，我们手动检查了所有类级别的代码片段。 如果某个类级别的代码片段包含函数级别的气味，我们就将其从数据集中排除。 为了进行评估，我们从表中总结的 385 个代码片段中选取了一个较小的样本集。 这些样本被随机打乱顺序。

sents.zh: 评估类级别代码气味的评审者仅关注类级别的气味类型（Madeyski 和 Lewowski，2020）。

sents.zh: 然而，函数级别的气味也可能存在于这些类中。

sents.en: To avoid ambiguity and ensure that each code snippet is associated with a single smell type, we manually checked all the class-level code snippets.
sents.zh: 为避免歧义并确保每个代码片段仅与单一气味类型相关，我们手动检查了所有类级别的代码片段。

sents.en: If a class-level code snippet contained a function-level smell, we excluded it from the dataset.
sents.zh: 如果某个类级别的代码片段包含函数级别的气味，我们就将其从数据集中排除。

sents.en: For our evaluation, we selected a reduced sample of 385 code snippets as summarized in Table 2 .
sents.zh: 为了进行评估，我们从表中总结的 385 个代码片段中选取了一个较小的样本集。

sents.en: These samples are randomly shuffled.
sents.zh: 这些样本被随机打乱顺序。

paragraphs.en: We used PrimeVul , a benchmark for training and evaluating code language models (LMs) on vulnerability detection tasks ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . Compared to other benchmarks, PrimeVul is designed to better capture the realistic challenges of detecting subtle vulnerabilities in source code. In this study, we specifically utilized the PrimeVul Pair subset, which presents a challenging benchmark as each vulnerable function is paired with a benign counterpart sharing at least 80% of their string content. This design emphasizes fine-grained distinctions between secure and insecure implementations, making the task significantly more realistic and difficult. The dataset we utilize contains 193 vulnerable and 193 benign functions, resulting in a total sample size of 386.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 PrimeVul，这是一个用于在漏洞检测任务中训练和评估代码语言模型（LMs）的基准数据集（Ding 等人，2025）。 与其他基准数据集相比，PrimeVul 的设计更能够捕捉到检测源代码中细微漏洞所面临的现实挑战。 在本研究中，我们特别使用了 PrimeVul Pair 子集，该子集构成一个具有挑战性的基准，因为每个脆弱函数都与其一个良性对应函数配对，且两者至少共享 80% 的字符串内容。 这种设计强调了安全与不安全实现之间的细微差异，使任务更具现实性和难度。 我们使用的数据集包含 193 个脆弱函数和 193 个良性函数，总样本量为 386。

paragraphs.en: For log-related tasks, we used datasets from LogHub , a large collection of system logs that are widely used for log parsing and anomaly detection research ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) . LogHub contains over 77 GB of logs collected from both real-world production systems and controlled lab environments. The collection includes both labeled and unlabeled datasets: labeled logs are annotated for specific tasks such as anomaly detection or issue identification, while unlabeled logs are suitable for general-purpose log analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 对于日志相关任务，我们使用了来自 LogHub 的数据集。LogHub 是一个大型系统日志集合，被广泛用于日志解析和异常检测研究（Zhu 等人，2023）。 LogHub 包含超过 77 GB 的日志，这些日志既来自真实的生产系统，也来自受控的实验室环境。 该集合包括带标签和不带标签的数据集：带标签的日志针对特定任务（如异常检测或问题识别）进行了标注，而不带标签的日志则适用于通用日志分析。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we chose HDFS due to its widespread adoption in log analysis research. The HDFS dataset contains logs from the Hadoop Distributed File System, a widely used distributed storage system. LogHub provides three HDFS variants (v1, v2, v3). We specifically used HDFS-v1, which was generated on a 203-node cluster running benchmark workloads, with anomalies manually labeled using handcrafted rules. The logs are organized into traces according to block IDs, and each trace is labeled as normal or abnormal . For our experiments, we used 385 log messages for the log parsing task and 385 sessions of log messages for the log analysis task, where each session corresponds to the logs associated with a specific block ID 2 2 2 https://github.com/logpai/loghub . To ensure that our experimental subset remained representative of the original dataset, we applied a stratified sampling strategy that preserves the original class distribution between normal and abnormal sessions for the log analysis task. In the HDFS dataset, anomalous sessions constitute approximately 3% of the data; therefore, our sampled subset maintains this ratio. While this approach improves representativeness, it also results in a highly imbalanced dataset, which we take into account in our analysis.

paragraphs.en: Rationale of the task and dataset selection: We selected the five software engineering tasks to cover complementary stages of the software lifecycle: code generation represents development-time automation, technical debt detection captures maintainability assessment, vulnerability detection addresses security analysis, while log parsing and log analysis represent operations and runtime system understanding. These tasks differ in reasoning complexity, input/output structure, and evaluation criteria, making them suitable for assessing whether agentic LLM configurations provide consistent benefits across heterogeneous software engineering scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 任务与数据集选择的依据：我们选择了五个软件工程任务，以覆盖软件生命周期的互补阶段：代码生成代表开发阶段的自动化，技术债务检测体现可维护性评估，漏洞检测涉及安全性分析，而日志解析和日志分析则分别代表运行操作以及对运行时系统的理解。 这些任务在推理复杂度、输入/输出结构以及评估标准上各不相同，因此适合用于评估智能体式 LLM 配置是否能在异构的软件工程场景中提供一致的优势。

paragraphs.en: For each task, we selected datasets that are widely used, publicly available, and suitable for reproducible evaluation. HumanEval was chosen for code generation because it provides executable programming problems with unit tests, enabling objective correctness measurement. MLCQ was selected for technical debt detection because it contains expert-reviewed code smell annotations at both function and class levels. PrimeVul was chosen for vulnerability detection because it provides realistic vulnerable and benign code pairs, supporting security-oriented code understanding. For log-related tasks, we selected LogHub/HDFS because it offers real-world log data with established templates and anomaly labels, enabling evaluation of both log parsing and log analysis under realistic operational conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们都选择了广泛使用、公开可用且适合可重复评估的数据集。 HumanEval 被选用于代码生成，因为它提供了带有单元测试的可执行编程问题，从而能够客观衡量正确性。 MLCQ 被选用于技术债务检测，因为它包含了经过专家审核的函数和类级别的代码异味标注。 PrimeVul 被选用于漏洞检测，因为它提供了逼真的脆弱代码与良性代码配对，支持面向安全的代码理解。 对于日志相关任务，我们选择了 LogHub/HDFS，因为它提供了具有既定模板和异常标签的真实世界日志数据，从而能够在真实的运行条件下评估日志解析和日志分析。

paragraphs.en: To systematically evaluate the impact of agentic collaboration on both task accuracy and energy consumption, we implemented four progressively collaborative configurations for each task, as shown in Figure 1 . Table 4 provides an overview of the configurations evaluated in this study. Designing multi-agent LLM systems involves a large design space, including the number of agents, their roles, and their communication and coordination strategies. Consequently, there is no single universally optimal multi-agent architecture for all software engineering tasks. In this study, our objective is not to propose a new task-specific multi-agent design, but rather to evaluate the cost–benefit trade-offs associated with increasing levels of agentic collaboration. Figure 1 therefore illustrates a generic orchestration pattern. The concrete implementations used in our experiments adopt role configurations inspired by patterns previously reported in the literature, allowing us to evaluate representative and validated multi-agent setups rather than claiming task-optimal designs. The set of configurations is explained in detail below:
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地评估智能体协作对任务准确率和能耗的影响，我们为每个任务实施了四种逐步增强协作性的配置，如图 1 所示。 表 4 概述了本研究中所评估的配置。 设计多智能体 LLM 系统涉及一个庞大的设计空间，包括智能体的数量、其角色以及通信与协调策略。 因此，并不存在适用于所有软件工程任务的单一通用最优多智能体架构。 在本研究中，我们的目标并非提出一种针对特定任务的新多智能体设计，而是评估提升智能体协作水平所带来的成本与收益权衡。 因此，图 1 展示了一种通用的编排模式。 我们实验中使用的具体实现采用了受文献中已有模式启发的角色配置，这使我们能够评估具有代表性和经过验证的多智能体设置，而非声称提出任务最优的设计。 以下将详细说明这些配置集合：

sents.en: The set of configurations is explained in detail below:
sents.zh: 以下将详细说明这些配置集合：

paragraphs.en: Non-Agentic (NA) : This configuration involves direct calls to the LLM without maintaining any state or exhibiting agent-like behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 非智能体（NA）：此配置涉及直接调用 LLM，而不会维持任何状态或表现出类似智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: Single Agent (SA) : A single LLM-based agent acts autonomously to complete the task (See the top part of Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 单智能体（SA）：一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体自主执行任务以完成任务（参见图2的上半部分）。

paragraphs.en: Dual Agent (DA) : This configuration includes two LLM-based agents with task-specific roles. For more structured tasks ( log parsing and technical debt detection ), a general Actor–Critic setup is used, where the Actor produces an initial output, and the Critic evaluates and finalizes it. For tasks requiring deeper domain reasoning, specialized roles are defined: in code generation , a Programmer who implements the solution and a Refiner who reviews and improves the Programmer’s output to produce the final response; in vulnerability detection , a Code Author who analyzes the code and explains its behavior, and a Security Analyst who reviews the Code Author’s reasoning and the code itself to make the final vulnerability decision; in log analysis , a Preprocessor parses the log messages in the given session and an Anomaly Detector that identifies whether the session contains anomalies based on the parsed output.
paragraphs.zh: 双智能体（DA）：此配置包含两个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体，各自承担与任务相关的特定角色。 对于结构更明确的任务（日志解析和技术债务检测），采用通用的演员-评论家架构，其中“演员”生成初始输出，“评论家”则对其进行评估并最终定稿。 对于需要更深层领域推理的任务，会定义专门的角色：在代码生成中，包括负责实现解决方案的“程序员”以及负责审查并改进“程序员”输出以生成最终响应的“优化者”；在漏洞检测中，包括负责分析代码并解释其行为的“代码编写者”，以及负责审查“代码编写者”的推理过程与代码本身以做出最终漏洞判断的“安全分析师”；在日志分析中，包括负责解析给定会话中日志消息的“预处理器”，以及基于解析结果判断该会话是否存在异常情况的“异常检测器”。

sents.en: Dual Agent (DA) : This configuration includes two LLM-based agents with task-specific roles.
sents.zh: 双智能体（DA）：此配置包含两个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体，各自承担与任务相关的特定角色。

sents.en: For more structured tasks ( log parsing and technical debt detection ), a general Actor–Critic setup is used, where the Actor produces an initial output, and the Critic evaluates and finalizes it.
sents.zh: 对于结构更明确的任务（日志解析和技术债务检测），采用通用的演员-评论家架构，其中“演员”生成初始输出，“评论家”则对其进行评估并最终定稿。

sents.en: For tasks requiring deeper domain reasoning, specialized roles are defined: in code generation , a Programmer who implements the solution and a Refiner who reviews and improves the Programmer’s output to produce the final response; in vulnerability detection , a Code Author who analyzes the code and explains its behavior, and a Security Analyst who reviews the Code Author’s reasoning and the code itself to make the final vulnerability decision; in log analysis , a Preprocessor parses the log messages in the given session and an Anomaly Detector that identifies whether the session contains anomalies based on the parsed output.
sents.zh: 对于需要更深层领域推理的任务，会定义专门的角色：在代码生成中，包括负责实现解决方案的“程序员”以及负责审查并改进“程序员”输出以生成最终响应的“优化者”；在漏洞检测中，包括负责分析代码并解释其行为的“代码编写者”，以及负责审查“代码编写者”的推理过程与代码本身以做出最终漏洞判断的“安全分析师”；在日志分析中，包括负责解析给定会话中日志消息的“预处理器”，以及基于解析结果判断该会话是否存在异常情况的“异常检测器”。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Agent (MA) : Four agents participate in a coordinated workflow with task-specific roles. The configurations follow established role-based cooperation, critique-and-refinement, and decision-aggregation patterns for LLM agents ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and are implemented using the conversational orchestration mechanisms provided by AG2/AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . For structured tasks ( log parsing and technical debt detection ), the workflow consists of a User Proxy that provides the input, an Actor (Generator) that produces an initial output, a Critic that evaluates it, and a Refiner that incorporates the feedback into the final response. For domain-specific tasks, we define specialized roles according to the analytical steps required by each task. For code generation , inspired by prior role-specialized generation and iterative review workflows ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , a Requirements Analyst interprets the task, a Programmer implements the solution, a Moderator reviews its correctness and quality, and a Review Board makes the final assessment. For vulnerability detection , we adopt the four-role mock-court configuration of VulTrial ( Widyasari et al., 2025 ) : a Security Researcher identifies potential vulnerabilities, a Code Author responds to the findings, a Moderator summarizes the discussion, and a Review Board makes the final decision. For log analysis , we introduce a task-specific decomposition in which a User Proxy provides the input session, a Preprocessor structures the log messages, an Anomaly Detector identifies potential anomalies, and a Critic reviews the findings and makes the final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体（MA）：四个智能体以具有特定任务角色的方式参与协同工作流程。 这些配置遵循针对大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）已确立的角色化协作、批判与优化以及决策聚合模式（Liu et al., 2025），并通过 AG2/AutoGen 提供的对话编排机制实现（Wu et al., 2023）。 对于结构化任务（日志解析和技术债务检测），工作流程包括一个提供输入的用户代理、一个生成初始输出的执行者（生成器）、一个对其进行评估的批判者，以及一个将反馈整合到最终回复中的优化者。 对于特定领域的任务，我们根据每项任务所需的分析步骤定义专门的角色。 在代码生成方面，受先前基于角色专业化的生成与迭代审查工作流程（Huang et al., 2023）启发，一名需求分析师解读任务，一名程序员实现解决方案，一名协调员审查其正确性和质量，最后由评审委员会做出最终评估。 在漏洞检测方面，我们采用 VulTrial 的四角色模拟法庭配置（Widyasari et al., 2025）：一名安全研究员识别潜在漏洞，一名代码编写者回应发现结果，一名协调员总结讨论内容，最后由评审委员会做出最终决定。 在日志分析方面，我们引入了一项任务特定的分解流程：用户代理提供输入会话，预处理器对日志消息进行结构化处理，异常检测器识别潜在异常，最后由批判者审查发现结果并做出最终决定。

sents.zh: 这些配置遵循针对大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）已确立的角色化协作、批判与优化以及决策聚合模式（Liu et al., 2025），并通过 AG2/AutoGen 提供的对话编排机制实现（Wu et al., 2023）。

sents.en: For structured tasks ( log parsing and technical debt detection ), the workflow consists of a User Proxy that provides the input, an Actor (Generator) that produces an initial output, a Critic that evaluates it, and a Refiner that incorporates the feedback into the final response.
sents.zh: 对于结构化任务（日志解析和技术债务检测），工作流程包括一个提供输入的用户代理、一个生成初始输出的执行者（生成器）、一个对其进行评估的批判者，以及一个将反馈整合到最终回复中的优化者。

sents.en: For domain-specific tasks, we define specialized roles according to the analytical steps required by each task.
sents.zh: 对于特定领域的任务，我们根据每项任务所需的分析步骤定义专门的角色。

sents.en: For code generation , inspired by prior role-specialized generation and iterative review workflows ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , a Requirements Analyst interprets the task, a Programmer implements the solution, a Moderator reviews its correctness and quality, and a Review Board makes the final assessment.
sents.zh: 在代码生成方面，受先前基于角色专业化的生成与迭代审查工作流程（Huang et al., 2023）启发，一名需求分析师解读任务，一名程序员实现解决方案，一名协调员审查其正确性和质量，最后由评审委员会做出最终评估。

sents.en: For vulnerability detection , we adopt the four-role mock-court configuration of VulTrial ( Widyasari et al., 2025 ) : a Security Researcher identifies potential vulnerabilities, a Code Author responds to the findings, a Moderator summarizes the discussion, and a Review Board makes the final decision.
sents.zh: 在漏洞检测方面，我们采用 VulTrial 的四角色模拟法庭配置（Widyasari et al., 2025）：一名安全研究员识别潜在漏洞，一名代码编写者回应发现结果，一名协调员总结讨论内容，最后由评审委员会做出最终决定。

sents.en: For log analysis , we introduce a task-specific decomposition in which a User Proxy provides the input session, a Preprocessor structures the log messages, an Anomaly Detector identifies potential anomalies, and a Critic reviews the findings and makes the final decision.
sents.zh: 在日志分析方面，我们引入了一项任务特定的分解流程：用户代理提供输入会话，预处理器对日志消息进行结构化处理，异常检测器识别潜在异常，最后由批判者审查发现结果并做出最终决定。

paragraphs.en: These configurations correspond to distinct collaboration mechanisms ( Tran et al., 2025 ) and agent design patterns ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , each representing a different level of agentic interaction and orchestration. The NA setup involves no collaboration or state maintenance, aligning with the one-shot model querying ( Liu et al., 2025 ) pattern. It serves as a non-agentic baseline with minimal reasoning and energy cost, providing a lower bound for performance comparison. The SA configuration corresponds to an agentic variant of the same pattern, where the LLM is encapsulated within an agent abstraction that manages prompts, execution flow, and internal state. Although NA and SA rely on a single LLM to complete the task and are therefore expected to yield comparable task performance, distinguishing them allows us to isolate and quantify the computational and energy overhead introduced by the agent abstraction itself. The DA configuration introduces competitive collaboration ( Tran et al., 2025 ) , associated with the debate-based cooperation and cross-reflection patterns ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . This setup enhances reasoning consistency and output reliability through adversarial feedback, albeit with increased communication and energy demands. Finally, the MA configuration embodies role-based coopetition ( Tran et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) and voting-based cooperation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) patterns, representing collective intelligence and division of labor among agents. This design is expected to produce more refined and robust task outcomes while introducing additional coordination overhead and energy consumption.
paragraphs.zh: 这些配置对应于不同的协作机制（Tran 等人，2025）和智能体设计模式（Liu 等人，2025），每种模式都代表了不同层级的智能体交互与协调。 NA 设置不涉及协作或状态维护，与单次查询模型（Liu 等人，2025）的模式一致。 它作为一个非智能体的基线，推理和能耗成本极低，为性能比较提供了下限。 SA 配置对应于同一模式的一种智能体变体，其中 LLM 被封装在一个智能体抽象层中，该层负责管理提示、执行流程和内部状态。 尽管 NA 和 SA 都依赖单个 LLM 完成任务，因此预计任务性能相近，但区分二者有助于我们隔离并量化智能体抽象本身带来的计算和能耗开销。 DA 配置引入了竞争性协作（Tran 等人，2025），与基于辩论的合作和交叉反思模式（Liu 等人，2025）相关。 这种设置通过对抗性反馈提升了推理的一致性和输出的可靠性，但同时也增加了通信和能耗需求。 最后，MA 配置体现了基于角色的竞合（Tran 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2025）和基于投票的合作（Liu 等人，2025）模式，代表了智能体之间的集体智慧和分工。 这种设计预计能产生更精细、更稳健的任务结果，但也会带来额外的协调开销和能耗。

paragraphs.en: Rationale of the configuration selection: The four configurations were selected to span a representative and interpretable spectrum of agentic complexity, from a direct LLM call to a coordinated four-agent workflow, rather than to exhaustively cover all possible multi-agent designs. This progression allows us to isolate the marginal cost and benefit of each additional level of orchestration, agent abstraction overhead (NA–>SA), adversarial feedback (SA–>DA), and collective role-based reasoning (DA–>MA), while keeping the experimental space tractable. The specific role assignments within DA and MA were informed by agent design patterns reported in the literature ( Widyasari et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , ensuring that the configurations reflect validated coordination strategies rather than arbitrary design choices. For structured tasks with well-defined input-output formats (log parsing, technical debt detection), generic Actor-Critic and User Proxy-Actor-Critic-Refiner patterns are appropriate because the task does not require domain-specific reasoning beyond what the prompt provides. For tasks involving nuanced code semantics or anomaly interpretation (code generation, vulnerability detection, log analysis), task-specific roles were assigned to give each agent a meaningful and distinct analytical function.
paragraphs.zh: 配置选择的依据：这四种配置被选中，旨在涵盖智能体复杂性的一个具有代表性和可解释性的范围，从直接调用 LLM 到协调四个智能体的工作流程，而非穷尽所有可能的多智能体设计。 这种递进使我们能够隔离出每个额外协调层级的边际成本与收益、智能体抽象带来的开销（NA→SA）、对抗性反馈（SA→DA）以及集体角色化推理（DA→MA），同时保持实验空间的可控性。 DA 和 MA 中的具体角色分配参考了文献中报道的智能体设计模式（Widyasari et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025），从而确保这些配置反映了经过验证的协调策略，而非随意的选择。 对于具有明确输入输出格式的结构性任务（日志解析、技术债务检测），通用的 Actor-Critic 和 User Proxy-Actor-Critic-Refiner 模式是合适的，因为此类任务不需要超出提示所提供的领域特定推理能力。 对于涉及细微代码语义或异常解读的任务（代码生成、漏洞检测、日志分析），则分配了任务特定的角色，以赋予每个智能体一个有意义且独特的分析功能。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated the models using Ollama ( Marcondes et al., 2025 ) , with each model configured using Ollama’s default context length (4096). To improve reproducibility and reduce output variability, all experiments were conducted with the temperature fixed at 0. Agent workflows were implemented using the AG2 framework (formerly AutoGen) 3 3 3 https://github.com/ag2ai/ag2 , an open-source platform for building multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Ollama（Marcondes 等人，2025）对模型进行了评估，每个模型均配置为使用 Ollama 的默认上下文长度（4096）。 为了提高可重复性并减少输出差异，所有实验均在温度固定为 0 的情况下进行。 智能体工作流是使用 AG2 框架（前身为 AutoGen）实现的 3 3 3 https://github.com/ag2ai/ag2 ，这是一个用于构建多智能体系统的开源平台。

sents.zh: 为了提高可重复性并减少输出差异，所有实验均在温度固定为 0 的情况下进行。

paragraphs.en: For prompt design, we adopted two strategies: zero-shot and few-shot prompting. In zero-shot prompting, the model receives only the task description, contextual information, and constraints, relying entirely on its pretrained knowledge. In few-shot prompting, the prompt additionally includes three manually selected labeled examples designed to capture diverse task-specific patterns (e.g., log event types, code smells, or code segments) to guide model behavior. These examples were not taken from the evaluation datasets to avoid data leakage. All prompt templates can be found in the replication package ( https://github.com/merveast/agent-green ).
paragraphs.zh: 在提示词设计方面，我们采用了两种策略：零样本提示和少样本提示。 在零样本提示中，模型仅接收任务描述、上下文信息和约束条件，完全依赖其预训练知识。 在少样本提示中，提示词还额外包含三个手动选择的带标签示例，这些示例旨在捕捉多样化的任务特定模式（例如，日志事件类型、代码异味或代码片段），以引导模型行为。 为避免数据泄露，这些示例并未从评估数据集中选取。 所有提示词模板均可在复现包中查找（ https://github.com/merveast/agent-green ）。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we utilize five models from three model families (i.e., Gemma family from Google, Qwen family from Alibaba, and DeepSeek-Coder family from DeepSeek AI) as listed below. Additionally, we evaluated gpt-oss:20b exclusively on one of the hardware configurations (the Server-SMU), as its 20B parameter size exceeded the capacity of the other hardware configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们使用了来自三个模型家族（即 Google 的 Gemma 家族、Alibaba 的 Qwen 家族和 DeepSeek AI 的 DeepSeek-Coder 家族）的五种模型，具体如列表所示。 此外，由于 gpt-oss:20b 的 20B 参数规模超过了其他硬件配置的能力，因此我们仅在一种硬件配置（Server-SMU）上对其进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: gemma3:4b : A compact general-purpose instruction-tuned model from Google’s Gemma familye ( Team et al., 2025 ) . We include this model to represent lightweight, resource-efficient LLMs that can be deployed on constrained hardware while still supporting reasoning and code-related tasks. Gemma 3 models provide a large context window and are designed for efficient local deployment.
paragraphs.zh: gemma3:4b：这是 Google Gemma 系列中的一个紧凑型通用指令微调模型（Team 等，2025）。 我们加入该模型，以代表那些能够在受限硬件上部署、同时仍能支持推理和代码相关任务的轻量级、资源高效的 LLM。 Gemma 3 模型提供了较大的上下文窗口，并专为高效的本地部署而设计。

sents.en: gemma3:4b : A compact general-purpose instruction-tuned model from Google’s Gemma familye ( Team et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: gemma3:4b：这是 Google Gemma 系列中的一个紧凑型通用指令微调模型（Team 等，2025）。

sents.en: We include this model to represent lightweight, resource-efficient LLMs that can be deployed on constrained hardware while still supporting reasoning and code-related tasks.
sents.zh: 我们加入该模型，以代表那些能够在受限硬件上部署、同时仍能支持推理和代码相关任务的轻量级、资源高效的 LLM。

sents.en: Gemma 3 models provide a large context window and are designed for efficient local deployment.
sents.zh: Gemma 3 模型提供了较大的上下文窗口，并专为高效的本地部署而设计。

paragraphs.en: codegemma:7b-instruct: A code-specialized instruction-tuned model from Google’s CodeGemma family ( Team et al., 2024 ) . CodeGemma is designed specifically for programming-related tasks such as code generation, completion, and code understanding. We include it as a representative open-source code-oriented model for evaluating software engineering workflows.
paragraphs.zh: codegemma:7b-instruct：这是 Google CodeGemma 系列中一个专注于代码的指令微调模型（Team 等，2024）。 CodeGemma 专为编程相关任务而设计，例如代码生成、补全和代码理解。 我们将其作为具有代表性的开源代码导向模型，用于评估软件工程工作流程。

sents.en: codegemma:7b-instruct: A code-specialized instruction-tuned model from Google’s CodeGemma family ( Team et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: codegemma:7b-instruct：这是 Google CodeGemma 系列中一个专注于代码的指令微调模型（Team 等，2024）。

sents.en: CodeGemma is designed specifically for programming-related tasks such as code generation, completion, and code understanding.
sents.zh: CodeGemma 专为编程相关任务而设计，例如代码生成、补全和代码理解。

sents.en: We include it as a representative open-source code-oriented model for evaluating software engineering workflows.
sents.zh: 我们将其作为具有代表性的开源代码导向模型，用于评估软件工程工作流程。

paragraphs.en: qwen3:4b-instruct: A compact instruction-tuned model from the Qwen3 family ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . We include it to evaluate whether a smaller general-purpose model with strong instruction-following and reasoning capabilities can provide competitive results with lower energy and latency costs.
paragraphs.zh: qwen3:4b-instruct：Qwen3 系列中的一个紧凑型指令微调模型（Yang 等，2025）。 我们将其纳入评估，以判断一个具备强大指令遵循和推理能力的小型通用模型，是否能在更低的能耗和延迟成本下提供具有竞争力的结果。

sents.en: qwen3:4b-instruct: A compact instruction-tuned model from the Qwen3 family ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: qwen3:4b-instruct：Qwen3 系列中的一个紧凑型指令微调模型（Yang 等，2025）。

sents.en: We include it to evaluate whether a smaller general-purpose model with strong instruction-following and reasoning capabilities can provide competitive results with lower energy and latency costs.
sents.zh: 我们将其纳入评估，以判断一个具备强大指令遵循和推理能力的小型通用模型，是否能在更低的能耗和延迟成本下提供具有竞争力的结果。

paragraphs.en: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct: A code-specialized instruction-tuned model from the Qwen2.5-Coder family ( Hui et al., 2024 ) . It is optimized for code generation, code reasoning, and code repair, making it directly relevant to the software engineering tasks considered in this study.
paragraphs.zh: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct：一个来自 Qwen2.5-Coder 系列的代码专用指令微调模型（Hui 等，2024）。 该模型针对代码生成、代码推理和代码修复进行了优化，因此与本研究涉及的软件工程任务直接相关。

sents.en: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct: A code-specialized instruction-tuned model from the Qwen2.5-Coder family ( Hui et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: Rationale of the model selection: The selected models cover three complementary dimensions of the experimental design. First, they include both general-purpose instruction-tuned models and code-specialized models, allowing us to compare whether domain-specific code models provide measurable benefits for software engineering tasks. Second, they span different parameter scales, from compact 4B models to a larger 20B model, enabling us to analyze how model size affects accuracy, latency, energy consumption, and CO 2 emissions. Third, the models originate from different model families, which reduces the risk that the findings are specific to a single architecture or training pipeline. This selection, therefore, supports a balanced evaluation of model capability, deployment feasibility, and sustainability across heterogeneous LLM configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 模型选择的依据：所选模型涵盖了实验设计的三个互补维度。 首先，它们既包括通用指令微调模型，也包括代码专用模型，使我们能够比较领域特定的代码模型是否为软件工程任务带来可量化的优势。 其次，它们的参数规模各不相同，从紧凑的 4B 模型到更大的 20B 模型，使我们能够分析模型规模如何影响准确性、延迟、能源消耗和二氧化碳排放量。 第三，这些模型来自不同的模型家族，从而降低了研究结果仅适用于单一架构或训练流程的风险。 因此，这种选择支持了对异构 LLM 配置下模型能力、部署可行性和可持续性的均衡评估。

sents.en: Rationale of the model selection: The selected models cover three complementary dimensions of the experimental design.
sents.zh: 模型选择的依据：所选模型涵盖了实验设计的三个互补维度。

sents.en: First, they include both general-purpose instruction-tuned models and code-specialized models, allowing us to compare whether domain-specific code models provide measurable benefits for software engineering tasks.
sents.zh: 首先，它们既包括通用指令微调模型，也包括代码专用模型，使我们能够比较领域特定的代码模型是否为软件工程任务带来可量化的优势。

sents.en: Second, they span different parameter scales, from compact 4B models to a larger 20B model, enabling us to analyze how model size affects accuracy, latency, energy consumption, and CO 2 emissions.
sents.zh: 其次，它们的参数规模各不相同，从紧凑的 4B 模型到更大的 20B 模型，使我们能够分析模型规模如何影响准确性、延迟、能源消耗和二氧化碳排放量。

sents.en: Third, the models originate from different model families, which reduces the risk that the findings are specific to a single architecture or training pipeline.
sents.zh: 第三，这些模型来自不同的模型家族，从而降低了研究结果仅适用于单一架构或训练流程的风险。

sents.en: This selection, therefore, supports a balanced evaluation of model capability, deployment feasibility, and sustainability across heterogeneous LLM configurations.
sents.zh: 因此，这种选择支持了对异构 LLM 配置下模型能力、部署可行性和可持续性的均衡评估。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 details the hardware platforms used in our data collection. The selected machines differ substantially in CPU architecture, memory capacity, GPU type, and available GPU memory, enabling us to evaluate how deployment environments influence the energy consumption, latency, and accuracy of LLM-based software engineering workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 详细说明了我们在数据收集过程中使用的硬件平台。 所选机器在 CPU 架构、内存容量、GPU 类型以及可用 GPU 内存方面存在显著差异，这使我们能够评估部署环境如何影响基于 LLM 的软件工程工作流程的能耗、延迟和准确性。

sents.en: Table 5 details the hardware platforms used in our data collection.
sents.zh: 表 5 详细说明了我们在数据收集过程中使用的硬件平台。

sents.en: The selected machines differ substantially in CPU architecture, memory capacity, GPU type, and available GPU memory, enabling us to evaluate how deployment environments influence the energy consumption, latency, and accuracy of LLM-based software engineering workflows.
sents.zh: 所选机器在 CPU 架构、内存容量、GPU 类型以及可用 GPU 内存方面存在显著差异，这使我们能够评估部署环境如何影响基于 LLM 的软件工程工作流程的能耗、延迟和准确性。

paragraphs.en: The Server-SMU machine represents a high-performance server configuration with substantial memory and multiple high-end GPUs. This setup enables the execution of larger models and more complex agentic workflows that require higher memory capacity and parallel computation. In particular, this machine was used for configurations that could not be executed on the other hardware platforms due to model-size and GPU-memory constraints.
paragraphs.zh: Server-SMU 机器代表一种高性能服务器配置，拥有充足的内存和多块高端 GPU。 这种配置能够运行更大的模型和更复杂的智能体工作流程，这些流程需要更高的内存容量和并行计算能力。 特别是，这台机器被用于那些因模型规模和 GPU 内存限制而无法在其他硬件平台上运行的配置。

sents.en: The Server-SMU machine represents a high-performance server configuration with substantial memory and multiple high-end GPUs.
sents.zh: Server-SMU 机器代表一种高性能服务器配置，拥有充足的内存和多块高端 GPU。

sents.zh: 特别是，这台机器被用于那些因模型规模和 GPU 内存限制而无法在其他硬件平台上运行的配置。

paragraphs.en: The Workstation-SMU machine represents a mid-range workstation environment. It provides a more moderate CPU, memory, and GPU configuration, allowing us to evaluate how LLM-based workflows perform on hardware that is more accessible than large-scale server infrastructure. This setup is useful for studying whether lightweight or moderately complex agentic configurations can be executed efficiently without requiring high-end server resources.
paragraphs.zh: Workstation-SMU 机器代表一种中端工作站环境。 它提供了较为适中的 CPU、内存和 GPU 配置，使我们能够评估基于 LLM 的工作流程在比大型服务器基础设施更易获得的硬件上的表现。 这种配置有助于研究轻量级或中等复杂度的智能体配置是否能够在无需高端服务器资源的情况下高效执行。

paragraphs.en: The Server-STF machine provides a second server-grade configuration with a different CPU generation and GPU architecture. By including this platform, we can compare the behavior of the same models and workflows across heterogeneous GPU environments and analyze whether energy consumption and latency trends remain consistent across different hardware setups.
paragraphs.zh: Server-STF 机器提供了第二种服务器级配置，采用不同代次的 CPU 和不同的 GPU 架构。 通过加入该平台，我们可以比较相同模型和工作流在不同异构 GPU 环境中的行为表现，并分析能耗和延迟趋势在不同硬件配置下是否保持一致。

sents.en: By including this platform, we can compare the behavior of the same models and workflows across heterogeneous GPU environments and analyze whether energy consumption and latency trends remain consistent across different hardware setups.
sents.zh: 通过加入该平台，我们可以比较相同模型和工作流在不同异构 GPU 环境中的行为表现，并分析能耗和延迟趋势在不同硬件配置下是否保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Rationale of the hardware selection: The hardware platforms were selected to cover a diverse range of realistic deployment settings for LLM-based software engineering tools. This diversity allows us to examine how hardware capabilities affect the feasibility and sustainability of different LLM configurations. The inclusion of both workstation- and server-grade machines enables comparison between accessible local deployment and more powerful infrastructure. Moreover, the variation in GPU memory and computational capacity allows us to study whether larger models and complex multi-agent workflows provide sufficient accuracy gains to justify their higher resource requirements. This hardware selection therefore supports a comprehensive analysis of performance–sustainability trade-offs across different computing environments.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件选择的依据：所选的硬件平台旨在覆盖基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件工程工具在实际部署中的多样化场景。 这种多样性使我们能够研究硬件能力如何影响不同 LLM 配置的实现可行性和可持续性。 同时纳入工作站级和服务器级设备，使得我们能够将易于获取的本地部署与性能更强大的基础设施进行比较。 此外，GPU 内存和计算能力的差异使我们能够研究：更大规模的模型和复杂的智能体多任务流程是否足以带来足够的准确性提升，从而证明其更高的资源需求是合理的。 因此，这种硬件选择支持了对不同计算环境中性能与可持续性之间权衡关系的全面分析。
