sents.zh: 然而，这些例外情况揭示了任务特性如何影响有效性与计算成本之间的平衡。

sents.en: For vulnerability detection, MA achieves the highest average F1-score (55.4%), whereas NA has the lowest energy consumption and latency.
sents.zh: 在漏洞检测任务中，MA的平均F1分数最高（55.4%），而NA的能耗和延迟最低。

sents.en: Although MA improves accuracy by 5.7 percentage points over NA, its substantially higher execution cost means that it appears on the balanced Pareto front for only one of the 15 task–hardware pairs.
sents.zh: 尽管MA的准确率比NA提高了5.7个百分点，但其执行成本显著更高，因此仅在15个任务-硬件组合中有一个组合上出现在平衡帕累托前沿上。

sents.en: This task illustrates that measurable accuracy improvements from additional agents do not necessarily translate into the best overall cost–performance trade-off.
sents.zh: 该任务表明，通过增加智能体所带来的可测量的准确率提升，并不必然意味着能获得最佳的整体成本-性能权衡。

sents.en: For code generation, SA is the balanced Pareto winner across all three hardware platforms, achieving 100% Pass@1 while incurring comparable or occasionally lower latency than NA.
sents.zh: 在代码生成任务中，SA在所有三种硬件平台上都是平衡帕累托最优解，实现了100%的Pass@1，同时延迟与NA相当或偶尔更低。

sents.en: Unlike the other tasks, the single-agent configuration preserves task accuracy while incurring little additional execution cost, making SA competitive with the NA configuration for this workload.
sents.zh: 与其他任务不同，单智能体配置既能保持任务准确率，又几乎不产生额外执行成本，这使得SA在这一工作负载中与NA配置具有竞争力。

sents.en: For technical debt detection, NA is the straightforward winner across all three objectives and all hardware platforms, with no tension between accuracy and cost.
sents.zh: 在技术债务检测任务中，NA在所有三个目标和所有硬件平台上都是直接的最佳选择，准确率和成本之间没有冲突。

sents.en: This task therefore provides the cleanest empirical support for the guideline to start non-agentic: additional orchestration neither improves accuracy nor reduces cost for this workload.
sents.zh: 因此，该任务为“从非智能体模式开始”这一指导原则提供了最清晰的实证支持：对于此工作负载，额外的协调机制既无法提高准确率，也无法降低成本。

sents.en: For log parsing, NA is the balanced Pareto winner across all three hardware platforms.
sents.zh: 在日志解析任务中，SA是所有三种硬件平台上的平衡帕累托最优解。

sents.en: This is consistent with the broader pattern, but notable given that log parsing is also the task where prompt strategy has the largest effect: few-shot prompting raises parsing accuracy from 3.4% to 54.3%, making it a more impactful lever than agentic configuration for this workload.
sents.zh: 这与整体规律一致，但值得注意的是，日志解析也是提示策略影响最大的任务：少样本提示将解析准确率从3.4%提升至54.3%，使其成为比智能体配置更具影响力的手段。

sents.en: For log analysis, SA is the most energy- and latency-efficient configuration, whereas NA achieves the highest average F1-score.
sents.zh: 在日志分析任务中，SA是能耗和延迟效率最高的配置，而NA则实现了最高的平均F1分数。

sents.en: Given the uniformly low absolute F1-scores for this task (5.5–7.5%), the practical differences between configurations are small, and the choice between NA and SA is unlikely to affect overall system performance materially.
sents.zh: 鉴于该任务的绝对F1分数普遍较低（5.5%–7.5%），不同配置之间的实际差异很小，选择NA或SA不太可能对系统整体性能产生实质性影响。

sents.en: We synthesize these per-task patterns into concrete design guidelines in Section 5 .
sents.zh: 我们在第5节中将这些各任务的具体模式整合为具体的设计指导原则。

paragraphs.en: This section synthesizes the findings of RQ1–RQ4 across tasks, configurations, models, and hardware platforms, and turns them into actionable design guidelines for sustainable LLM-based developer tools. Finally, we discuss the practical implications for tool builders and researchers.
paragraphs.zh: 本节综合了 RQ1–RQ4 在各个任务、配置、模型和硬件平台上的研究结果，并将其转化为适用于可持续 LLM 基开发工具的可操作设计指南。 最后，我们讨论了这些发现对工具构建者和研究人员具有的实际意义。

sents.en: This section synthesizes the findings of RQ1–RQ4 across tasks, configurations, models, and hardware platforms, and turns them into actionable design guidelines for sustainable LLM-based developer tools.
sents.zh: 本节综合了 RQ1–RQ4 在各个任务、配置、模型和硬件平台上的研究结果，并将其转化为适用于可持续 LLM 基开发工具的可操作设计指南。

sents.en: Finally, we discuss the practical implications for tool builders and researchers.
sents.zh: 最后，我们讨论了这些发现对工具构建者和研究人员具有的实际意义。

paragraphs.en: Four patterns emerge consistently across the four research questions. Together they reframe the role of each design lever in agentic LLM systems for software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个研究问题中，始终出现了四种模式。 它们共同重新定义了智能体式大型语言模型系统在软件工程中的每个设计杠杆的作用。

sents.en: Four patterns emerge consistently across the four research questions.
sents.zh: 在四个研究问题中，始终出现了四种模式。

sents.en: Together they reframe the role of each design lever in agentic LLM systems for software engineering.
sents.zh: 它们共同重新定义了智能体式大型语言模型系统在软件工程中的每个设计杠杆的作用。

paragraphs.en: Agentic configuration is one of the largest single drivers of system behaviour in our study, but its effect on accuracy is not monotonic. On accuracy, NA obtains the highest mean score for four of the five tasks, while MA is the strongest configuration for vulnerability detection. Adding agents otherwise leaves accuracy roughly unchanged (code generation, technical debt detection, log analysis) or degrades it (log parsing, and DA for vulnerability detection). On cost, the same axis grows steeply: averaged across tasks, hardware, models, and prompts, MA consumes 6.36 × \times as much energy and runs 6.07 × \times as long as NA, with worst-case slowdowns of up to 160 × \times for individual task–hardware pairs. The asymmetry is therefore that accuracy gains from additional agents are rare and task-specific, while the resource cost is systematic. The Pareto analysis in RQ4 makes this concrete, showing that out of 66 Pareto-optimal configurations across all task–hardware pairs, 36 are NA, 23 are SA, 6 are DA, and only 1 is MA. This does not mean that one should in general not use agents, but that there should be a clear justification for using them. Our findings complement the recent work of Tran and Kiela ( Tran and Kiela, 2026 ) , who show that under matched reasoning-token budgets, single-agent systems consistently match or outperform multi-agent systems on multi-hop reasoning tasks. While their study focuses on reasoning under equal compute budgets and explains this behavior through an information-theoretic perspective, our results reveal a similar pattern across a broader range of software engineering tasks under realistic deployment conditions while explicitly quantifying the associated energy and latency costs. Across five software engineering tasks, additional agents provide only limited, task-specific accuracy improvements while imposing systematic increases in energy consumption and inference latency. The two studies therefore converge on the same practical conclusion from different perspectives: agentic complexity should not be treated as a default design choice but adopted only when there is clear evidence of a task-specific benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体配置是我们研究中影响系统行为的最主要单一因素之一，但其对准确性的影响并非单调的。 在准确性方面，NA 在五项任务中的四项获得了最高的平均得分，而 MA 则是漏洞检测中最强的配置。 除此之外，添加智能体对准确性的影响大致保持不变（代码生成、技术债务检测、日志分析），或导致其下降（日志解析以及漏洞检测中的 DA）。 在成本方面，同一指标急剧上升：跨任务、硬件、模型和提示的平均来看，MA 消耗的能量是 NA 的 6.36 × \times，运行时间也长 6.07 × \times，个别任务与硬件组合的最慢情况甚至可达 160 × \times。 因此，这种不对称性体现在：通过增加智能体获得的准确性提升既罕见又依赖于具体任务，而资源成本则是系统性的。 RQ4 中的帕累托分析使这一点更加具体：在所有任务与硬件组合中，共有 66 种帕累托最优配置，其中 36 种为 NA、23 种为 SA、6 种为 DA，而 MA 仅有一种。 这并不意味着通常不应使用智能体，而是意味着使用它们时必须有明确的理由。 我们的研究补充了 Tran 和 Kiela（Tran and Kiela, 2026）近期的工作，他们指出，在推理令牌预算匹配的情况下，单智能体系统在多跳推理任务中始终与多智能体系统表现相当或更优。 尽管他们的研究聚焦于计算资源相等条件下的推理，并从信息论角度解释了这一现象，但我们的结果在更广泛的软件工程任务和现实部署条件下揭示了类似的模式，同时明确量化了相关的能量和延迟成本。 在五项软件工程任务中，增加智能体仅带来有限且依赖具体任务的准确性提升，同时却系统性地增加了能耗和推理延迟。 因此，这两项研究从不同视角得出了相同的实践结论：不应将智能体复杂性视为默认的设计选择，而只有在有明确证据表明其能为特定任务带来益处时，才应采用。

paragraphs.en: While agentic configuration has a mostly monotonic cost effect, model and prompt have heterogeneous effects whose direction depends on the task. RQ1 shows that no single model is best across all tasks (Pass@1 is maximized by G3-4B, Macro F1 for technical debt by GPT-OSS, vulnerability F1 by Q3-4B, and the two log metrics by Q2.5C-7B), and that prompt strategy can swing log-parsing accuracy from 3.4% to 54.3%. RQ2 shows that the lowest-energy model also varies by task, and that the energy gap between models is often larger than the gap between hardware platforms for the same configuration. Figure 14 makes the absence of a universal winner visually explicit: the best accuracy model varies by task, with Q2.5C-7B leading both log tasks, while the lowest-energy model also varies, with CG-7B recurring across several tasks. Model and prompt are therefore the levers that actually deliver task-specific performance improvements, but they require per-task tuning rather than a single global default.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然智能体配置的成本影响基本是单调的，但模型和提示词的影响则各不相同，其方向取决于具体任务。 RQ1 表明，没有任何一个模型在所有任务中都是最佳选择（Pass@1 的最佳模型是 G3-4B，技术债务的 Macro F1 最佳模型是 GPT-OSS，漏洞检测的 F1 最佳模型是 Q3-4B，而两个日志指标的最佳模型则是 Q2.5C-7B）；同时，提示词策略可使日志解析准确率从 3.4% 波动到 54.3%。 RQ2 表明，能耗最低的模型也会因任务而异，且不同模型之间的能耗差距通常大于相同配置下不同硬件平台之间的差距。 图 14 直观地揭示了“不存在通用最优解”这一现象：最佳准确率的模型因任务而异，其中 Q2.5C-7B 在两个日志任务中均表现领先；而能耗最低的模型也不固定，CG-7B 在多个任务中反复出现。 因此，模型和提示词才是真正能带来特定任务性能提升的关键因素，但它们需要针对每个任务进行单独调整，而非采用单一的通用默认设置。

paragraphs.en: Hardware is the only factor that does not have a strong direct effect on accuracy: across the hardware-balanced subset, accuracy varies by less than 3 percentage points between the three platforms. On the cost side, hardware effects are modest for NA and SA but widen substantially for DA and MA: MA on Workstation-SMU is 3.4 × \times slower than MA on Server-STF, and the energy gap follows the same direction. Hardware selection therefore becomes a first-order concern primarily as a function of the agentic configuration it is asked to run; it amplifies rather than counteracts the agentic cost.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件是唯一一个对准确率没有显著直接影响的因素：在硬件均衡的子集中，三个平台之间的准确率差异不到 3 个百分点。 在成本方面，硬件对 NA 和 SA 的影响较小，但对 DA 和 MA 的影响则显著扩大：Workstation-SMU 上的 MA 比 Server-STF 上的 MA 慢 3.4 倍（\times），且能耗差距也呈现出相同趋势。 因此，硬件选择主要取决于需要运行的智能体配置，成为首要考虑因素；它会放大而非抵消智能体的成本。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 shows a near-perfect log–log correlation between energy and latency ( r = 0.987 r=0.987 ), driven by the fact that local inference on the same hardware draws roughly constant power. As a consequence, energy savings and latency savings are largely co-achieved, where a configuration change that reduces one will almost always reduce the other. Accuracy, in contrast, is decoupled from this axis—it depends on whether the chosen model and prompt are appropriate for the task, not on how much energy the configuration consumes.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 显示能量与延迟之间存在近乎完美的对数-对数相关性（r = 0.987 r=0.987），这是因为在同一硬件上进行本地推理所消耗的功率大致恒定。 因此，能量节省和延迟节省在很大程度上是同步实现的：任何能够减少其中一项的配置变更，几乎总会同时减少另一项。 相比之下，准确性则与这一轴无关——它取决于所选模型和提示是否适合当前任务，而非配置消耗的能量多少。

paragraphs.en: Drawing on the insights above, we offer the following guidelines for practitioners building LLM-based developer tools. Each guideline is based on our RQ findings.
paragraphs.zh: 基于上述见解，我们为构建基于大型语言模型的开发者工具的实践者提供以下指导方针。 每一条指导方针都基于我们对研究问题的发现。

sents.en: Drawing on the insights above, we offer the following guidelines for practitioners building LLM-based developer tools.
sents.zh: 基于上述见解，我们为构建基于大型语言模型的开发者工具的实践者提供以下指导方针。

sents.en: Each guideline is based on our RQ findings.
sents.zh: 每一条指导方针都基于我们对研究问题的发现。

paragraphs.en: For all five tasks studied, NA is the best or tied-for-best configuration on at least one of accuracy, energy, or latency, and it dominates the Pareto front (55% of all Pareto-optimal configurations). Adding agents should be treated as a hypothesis to test, and not a default. SA is a reasonable next step when a measurable task-specific benefit is observed; DA and MA should be reserved for tasks, such as vulnerability detection in our results, where there is concrete evidence that multi-round reasoning helps enough to justify the cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有研究的五个任务中，NA 至少在准确性、能耗或延迟这三个指标中的至少一个上表现最佳或与最佳配置并列，并且它主导了帕累托前沿（占所有帕累托最优配置的 55%）。 添加智能体应被视为一个需要验证的假设，而非默认选择。 当观察到可量化的任务特定收益时，SA 是一个合理的后续步骤；而 DA 和 MA 则应保留用于那些有明确证据表明多轮推理足以抵消其成本的任务，例如我们研究结果中的漏洞检测任务。

paragraphs.en: Model choice has a larger and more task-specific effect than agentic configuration. Table 13 can be used as a starting point: G3-4B for code generation, GPT-OSS or G3-4B for technical debt detection, Q3-4B for vulnerability detection, Q2.5C-7B for log tasks where accuracy is paramount, and CG-7B/Q3-4B when energy efficiency is important. The attractiveness of a model depends on whether it is sufficient for the task, and not on its parameter count alone: smaller is not automatically more efficient (e.g., Q2.5C-7B can consume more than two orders of magnitude more energy than the best model on log parsing).
paragraphs.zh: 模型选择的影响比智能体配置更大，且更具任务特异性。 表13可用作参考起点：代码生成选用G3-4B，技术债务检测选用GPT-OSS或G3-4B，漏洞检测选用Q3-4B，对准确性要求极高的日志任务选用Q2.5C-7B，而若能效重要，则选用CG-7B/Q3-4B。 一个模型是否具有吸引力，取决于它是否足以应对任务，而非仅由其参数数量决定：较小的模型并不自动意味着更高效（例如，Q2.5C-7B在日志解析任务中消耗的能量可能比最佳模型多两个数量级以上）。

sents.zh: 模型选择的影响比智能体配置更大，且更具任务特异性。

paragraphs.en: Few-shot prompting is the single most impactful lever for log parsing, raising parsing accuracy from 3.4% to 54.3% and reducing energy by 24–41%. It also reduces energy for technical debt detection. For code generation, however, few-shot examples can hurt both accuracy and energy. Few-shot prompting is therefore appropriate when the task is sensitive to output format, and should be tested empirically otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 小样本提示是日志解析中影响最大的手段，它将解析准确率从 3.4% 提升至 54.3%，并将能耗降低了 24–41%。 它还能降低技术债务检测的能耗。 然而，在代码生成方面，小样本示例可能会同时损害准确率和增加能耗。 因此，当任务对输出格式敏感时，使用小样本提示是合适的；否则应通过实证测试加以验证。

paragraphs.en: For lightweight (NA/SA) workloads, hardware differences are modest, and choices can be driven by availability or cost. For heavier (DA/MA) workloads, hardware becomes a first-order concern: high-end servers can be 3.4 × \times faster than workstations on MA, and the energy gap widens accordingly. If the workload must be agentic, invest in suitable hardware; otherwise, the savings from a simpler architecture exceed the savings from upgrading hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 对于轻量级（NA/SA）工作负载，硬件差异不大，选择可以基于可用性或成本来决定。 对于更重的工作负载（DA/MA），硬件成为首要考虑因素：在 MA 场景下，高端服务器的速度可达工作站的 3.4 倍，能量差距也会随之扩大。 如果工作负载必须依赖智能体，则应投资合适的硬件；否则，采用更简单架构所节省的成本将超过升级硬件带来的收益。

paragraphs.en: The strong correlation between energy and latency (RQ3) and the dominance of lightweight configurations on the Pareto front (RQ4) only become visible because all four dimensions were measured uniformly. We encourage authors of new agentic systems to publish accuracy together with energy on a fixed reference platform, so that the community can compare designs on a more complete basis than accuracy alone.
paragraphs.zh: 能量与延迟之间的强相关性（RQ3）以及帕累托前沿上轻量级配置的主导地位（RQ4），之所以能够显现出来，是因为所有四个维度都是以统一的方式测量的。 我们鼓励新型智能体系统的作者在固定参考平台上同时公布准确率和能耗数据，以便整个研究社区能够基于比仅凭准确率更全面的基准来比较不同设计。

sents.zh: 能量与延迟之间的强相关性（RQ3）以及帕累托前沿上轻量级配置的主导地位（RQ4），之所以能够显现出来，是因为所有四个维度都是以统一的方式测量的。

paragraphs.en: The strongest practical takeaway is that competitive developer tools can be built around lightweight LLM configurations, provided that the model and prompt are matched to the task. Multi-agent orchestration should be added selectively, instrumented with energy or latency reporting, and validated against a non-agentic baseline before being shipped to users.
paragraphs.zh: 最实用的结论是，只要模型和提示词与任务相匹配，就可以围绕轻量级 LLM 配置构建具有竞争力的开发者工具。 多智能体协调应选择性添加，并加入能量或延迟报告机制，在发布给用户之前，还需与非智能体基准方案进行验证。

sents.zh: 最实用的结论是，只要模型和提示词与任务相匹配，就可以围绕轻量级 LLM 配置构建具有竞争力的开发者工具。

sents.en: Multi-agent orchestration should be added selectively, instrumented with energy or latency reporting, and validated against a non-agentic baseline before being shipped to users.
sents.zh: 多智能体协调应选择性添加，并加入能量或延迟报告机制，在发布给用户之前，还需与非智能体基准方案进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Many existing comparisons of agentic systems report only accuracy and only on a single task. Our results show that conclusions drawn from such single-axis evaluations may be misleading: configurations that look attractive on accuracy alone (e.g., MA on vulnerability detection) can be substantially more expensive than lower-cost alternatives, while configurations that look attractive on cost alone may be insufficient for tasks where the accuracy gap matters. We advocate for multi-objective, multi-task evaluation as a standard practice for agentic LLM research.
paragraphs.zh: 许多现有的智能体系统比较研究仅报告了准确性，且只针对单一任务。 我们的研究结果表明，基于此类单维度评估得出的结论可能具有误导性：仅从准确性来看似乎很有吸引力的配置（例如，在漏洞检测中使用 MA），其成本可能远高于成本更低的替代方案；而仅从成本角度看似乎很有吸引力的配置，则可能在准确性差异至关重要的任务中表现不足。 我们倡导将多目标、多任务的评估作为智能体大语言模型研究的标准化实践。

paragraphs.en: The energy footprint of agentic LLM systems is not determined by any single design choice, but by the multiplicative interaction of model, agent configuration, prompt, and hardware. Across our 1,840 experimental runs, the campaign consumed approximately 651.7 kWh of electricity, which CodeCarbon translates to roughly 110.8 kg CO 2 e at the default carbon intensity used in our experiments (mean implied intensity 0.170 kg CO 2 e/kWh). The absolute number is modest—comparable to a few hundred kilometres of driving an average passenger car ( U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, 2026 ) —but it is dominated by a small subset of configurations: the most expensive single configuration alone accounts for about 5.5 kg CO 2 e, while the median configuration is roughly two orders of magnitude lower. This means that emissions reduction in agentic LLM workflows is not a question of small efficiency gains across the board, but more about avoiding the worst configurations. We therefore caution against treating CO 2 as a stand-alone indicator: under a fixed carbon-intensity assumption, it is a linear transformation of energy and adds no analytical insight beyond the energy results, but its translation into emissions depends strongly on when and where a model is run. Sustainability assessments of agentic systems should report energy at a fixed reference platform (so that designs can be compared) together with a transparent CO 2 estimate that makes the carbon-intensity assumption explicit, and they should highlight the long tail of high-cost configurations rather than the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型系统的能源足迹并非由任何单一的设计决策决定，而是由模型、智能体配置、提示词和硬件之间的乘性相互作用所决定。在我们进行的 1,840 次实验运行中，整个项目消耗了约 651.7 千瓦时的电力，根据 CodeCarbon 的换算，这一数值在实验中使用的默认碳强度下约为 110.8 千克二氧化碳当量（隐含平均强度为 0.170 千克二氧化碳当量/千瓦时）。这一绝对数值看似不大——相当于驾驶一辆普通乘用车行驶数百公里（美国环境保护署，2026）——但其中大部分消耗来自一小部分配置：仅最昂贵的单一配置就产生了约 5.5 千克二氧化碳当量，而中位数配置则低大约两个数量级。这意味着，智能体式大语言模型工作流程中的减排问题，并非在于全面实现微小的效率提升，而在于避免使用那些成本最高的配置。因此，我们提醒不要将二氧化碳当量视为一个独立的指标：在固定碳强度的假设下，它只是能源消耗的一个线性转换，并未提供超出能源结果之外的分析洞见；而将其转化为具体排放量时，则高度依赖于模型运行时间和地点。对智能体系统的可持续性评估应报告在固定参考平台上的能源消耗（以便不同设计之间进行比较），同时提供透明的二氧化碳当量估算，并明确说明所采用的碳强度假设；此外，评估还应关注高成本配置的长尾分布，而非仅聚焦于平均值。

paragraphs.en: Threats to internal validity concern whether the observed effects can be attributed to the experimental factors we studied. To counter such threats, we used fixed prompts and datasets, set the temperature to 0 0 , disabled agent-level caching, restarted the Ollama server between runs, and executed repeated trials under the same protocol. Still, some sources of stochasticity may remain, such as low-level nondeterminism due to GPU kernels, model-serving behavior, and hardware state. Our three repeated runs per configuration (except for GPT-OSS) capture some variability, but do not fully represent long-term variation due to system temperature, background services, or hardware aging. Results involving GPT-OSS should therefore be interpreted with additional caution, since this model was only evaluated on one hardware platform and without repeated runs. To reduce the risk that hardware constraints affected the accuracy analysis, we have done balanced hardware comparisons for RQ1 by averaging the numbers across hardware platforms before averaging across experimentation configurations, preventing that the models run on multiple hardware platforms are weighted more than the GPT-OSS model in the reported numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 对内部效度的威胁涉及观察到的效应是否可以归因于我们所研究的实验因素。 为应对此类威胁，我们使用了固定的提示词和数据集，将温度设为 0.0，禁用了智能体级别的缓存，在每次运行之间重启了 Ollama 服务器，并在相同协议下执行了重复试验。 尽管如此，某些随机性来源可能仍然存在，例如由 GPU 内核、模型服务行为及硬件状态引起的底层非确定性。 我们对每种配置进行了三次重复运行（GPT-OSS 除外），这捕捉到了一定程度的变异性，但并未完全反映因系统温度、后台服务或硬件老化而导致的长期变化。 因此，涉及 GPT-OSS 的结果应予以额外谨慎的解读，因为该模型仅在单一硬件平台上进行了评估，且未进行重复运行。 为降低硬件限制影响准确性分析的风险，我们在研究问题 1（RQ1）中通过先对跨硬件平台的数值取平均，再对实验配置取平均的方式，实现了均衡的硬件对比，从而避免在报告结果中使运行于多个硬件平台上的模型比 GPT-OSS 模型获得更高的权重。

paragraphs.en: External validity concerns the generalizability of our findings. We evaluate five different software engineering tasks, which gives a broader coverage than single-task benchmarks, but it is still only a subset of developer workflows. The results may not generalize to tasks such as code review, test generation, repository-level maintenance, or autonomous development. The generalizability is also restricted by the datasets, since real-life use cases generally involve more complex, noisy data and larger inputs compared to the curated benchmark datasets used to evaluate each configuration in this study. Additionally, the datasets used in this study cover a limited set of programming languages: HumanEval targets Python, and the MLCQ and PrimeVul datasets consist of Java and C/C++ code, respectively. The findings on code generation, technical debt detection, and vulnerability detection may therefore not generalize to other languages, particularly those with different syntactic structures, ecosystem conventions, or levels of LLM training coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度涉及我们研究结果的可推广性。 我们评估了五个不同的软件工程任务，这比单一任务的基准测试覆盖范围更广，但仍然只是开发者工作流程的一个子集。 这些结果可能无法推广到代码审查、测试生成、仓库级维护或自主开发等任务。 可推广性也受到数据集的限制，因为现实生活中的使用场景通常涉及比本研究用于评估每种配置的精选基准数据集更复杂、更嘈杂的数据和更大的输入。 此外，本研究使用的数据集仅涵盖有限的编程语言：HumanEval 针对 Python，而 MLCQ 和 PrimeVul 数据集则分别包含 Java 和 C/C++ 代码。 因此，关于代码生成、技术债务检测和漏洞检测的研究结果可能无法推广到其他语言，尤其是那些具有不同语法结构、生态系统惯例或 LLM 训练覆盖程度的语言。

sents.en: External validity concerns the generalizability of our findings.
sents.zh: 外部效度涉及我们研究结果的可推广性。

sents.en: We evaluate five different software engineering tasks, which gives a broader coverage than single-task benchmarks, but it is still only a subset of developer workflows.
sents.zh: 我们评估了五个不同的软件工程任务，这比单一任务的基准测试覆盖范围更广，但仍然只是开发者工作流程的一个子集。

sents.en: The results may not generalize to tasks such as code review, test generation, repository-level maintenance, or autonomous development.
sents.zh: 这些结果可能无法推广到代码审查、测试生成、仓库级维护或自主开发等任务。

sents.en: The generalizability is also restricted by the datasets, since real-life use cases generally involve more complex, noisy data and larger inputs compared to the curated benchmark datasets used to evaluate each configuration in this study.
sents.zh: 可推广性也受到数据集的限制，因为现实生活中的使用场景通常涉及比本研究用于评估每种配置的精选基准数据集更复杂、更嘈杂的数据和更大的输入。

sents.en: Additionally, the datasets used in this study cover a limited set of programming languages: HumanEval targets Python, and the MLCQ and PrimeVul datasets consist of Java and C/C++ code, respectively.
sents.zh: 此外，本研究使用的数据集仅涵盖有限的编程语言：HumanEval 针对 Python，而 MLCQ 和 PrimeVul 数据集则分别包含 Java 和 C/C++ 代码。

sents.en: The findings on code generation, technical debt detection, and vulnerability detection may therefore not generalize to other languages, particularly those with different syntactic structures, ecosystem conventions, or levels of LLM training coverage.
sents.zh: 因此，关于代码生成、技术债务检测和漏洞检测的研究结果可能无法推广到其他语言，尤其是那些具有不同语法结构、生态系统惯例或 LLM 训练覆盖程度的语言。

paragraphs.en: The model and hardware choices also present a threat to external validity, as we have evaluated only small, local LLMs with a maximum of 20 billion parameters. Results may differ for larger models, and particularly frontier models. Publicly hosted frontier models, however, do not allow direct local measurement of energy consumption, which was one of the main aims of this study. Similarly, cloud deployments may behave differently because of batching, virtualization, datacenter power usage effectiveness, cooling infrastructure, and location-specific carbon intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 模型和硬件的选择也对外部效度构成威胁，因为我们仅评估了参数最多为200亿的小型本地大语言模型。 对于更大的模型，尤其是前沿模型，结果可能会有所不同。 然而，公开托管的前沿模型不允许直接进行本地能耗测量，而这正是本研究的主要目标之一。 同样地，由于批处理、虚拟化、数据中心的能效、冷却基础设施以及特定地点的碳强度，云部署的表现也可能有所不同。

sents.en: Similarly, cloud deployments may behave differently because of batching, virtualization, datacenter power usage effectiveness, cooling infrastructure, and location-specific carbon intensity.
sents.zh: 同样地，由于批处理、虚拟化、数据中心的能效、冷却基础设施以及特定地点的碳强度，云部署的表现也可能有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Our results are affected by our specific implementation of the agentic configurations and the prompts used for the various tasks. Agentic systems can be designed in a multitude of ways, and small details can create significant changes. For simpler, more structured tasks such as log parsing and technical debt detection, we adopted generic orchestration patterns (Actor–Critic and User Proxy–Actor–Critic–Refiner) that are broadly applicable across tasks. For tasks requiring deeper domain reasoning (vulnerability detection, log analysis, and code generation), we defined task-specific agent roles informed by prior literature, allowing us to evaluate representative and validated multi-agent setups rather than purely generic ones. More specialized or extensively tuned multi-agent designs could yield different accuracy results for individual tasks, particularly for vulnerability detection where our MA configuration already shows a meaningful accuracy advantage. Our claim is therefore not that the specific configurations studied are optimal, but that they represent realistic design choices a practitioner would make. The finding that lightweight configurations dominate the Pareto front should be read as evidence about the cost–benefit ratio of typical agentic orchestration, not as a proof that no multi-agent design can ever achieve a better accuracy–energy trade-off. Future work could explore the multi-agent design space for individual tasks to identify whether more task-specialized orchestration can shift the Pareto frontier.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果受到智能体配置的具体实现方式以及各项任务中所用提示词的影响。 智能体系统可以有多种不同的设计方式，而细微的差异也可能带来显著的变化。 对于日志解析和技术债务检测这类更简单、结构更清晰的任务，我们采用了通用的编排模式（Actor–Critic 和 User Proxy–Actor–Critic–Refiner），这些模式在不同任务中都具有广泛的适用性。 对于需要更深层领域推理的任务（漏洞检测、日志分析和代码生成），我们基于既有文献定义了特定于任务的智能体角色，从而能够评估具有代表性和经过验证的多智能体配置，而非纯粹通用的配置。 更加专业或经过深度优化的多智能体设计可能会在单个任务中产生不同的准确率结果，尤其是在漏洞检测方面，我们的 MA 配置已经展现出明显的准确率优势。 因此，我们的主张并非认为所研究的具体配置是最优的，而是认为它们代表了实际从业者会做出的合理设计选择。 轻量级配置在帕累托前沿中占据主导地位这一发现，应被解读为对典型智能体编排成本与收益比的一种证据，而非证明任何多智能体设计都无法实现更优的准确率–能耗权衡。 未来的研究可以针对单个任务探索多智能体的设计空间，以判断是否存在更具任务针对性的编排方式能够推动帕累托边界的进一步扩展。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity concerns whether the measurements used in the study capture the concepts we intend to analyze. For task performance, we use the term accuracy as an umbrella term, while the actual metric is task-specific: Pass@1 for code generation, Macro F1 and per-class F1 for technical debt detection, F1-score for vulnerability detection and log analysis, and parsing accuracy for log parsing. This improves the fit between metric and task, but it also means that performance values are not directly interchangeable across tasks. Cross-task averages should therefore be interpreted as summaries of relative behavior across the benchmark suite, not as a single universal measure of software engineering capability.
paragraphs.zh: 构效度涉及研究中所使用的测量方法是否准确捕捉了我们意图分析的概念。 在任务表现方面，我们将“准确性”用作一个统称，而具体指标则因任务而异：代码生成任务使用 Pass@1，技术债务检测任务使用 Macro F1 和每个类别的 F1，漏洞检测与日志分析任务使用 F1 分数，日志解析任务则使用解析准确性。 这提升了指标与任务之间的匹配度，但也意味着不同任务中的表现值无法直接相互比较。 因此，跨任务的平均值应被理解为基准测试套件中相对表现的总结，而非衡量软件工程能力的单一通用指标。

paragraphs.en: The technical debt task is a particular construct-validity risk because plain accuracy can hide poor performance on minority smell classes. We mitigate this by using Macro F1 as the primary task metric and by reporting per-class F1 scores. However, these metrics still reduce a complex code-quality judgment to a fixed-label classification problem and do not capture severity, maintainability impact, or disagreement among human reviewers.
paragraphs.zh: 技术债务任务是一种特定的结构有效性风险，因为单纯的准确率可能会掩盖对少数“异味”类别的较差表现。 我们通过将宏观 F1 用作主要任务指标，并报告每个类别的 F1 分数来缓解这一问题。 然而，这些指标仍将复杂的代码质量判断简化为固定标签的分类问题，并且无法捕捉到严重性、可维护性影响或人类评审者之间的分歧。

paragraphs.en: Energy consumption and latency are also affected by specific measurement choices. CodeCarbon estimates process-level energy consumption from CPU, GPU, and memory signals rather than measuring wall-socket energy with external instrumentation. This provides a consistent basis for comparing configurations, but it may result in greater uncertainty, depending on the idle power draw on various hardware platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 能源消耗和延迟也会受到具体测量选择的影响。 CodeCarbon 通过 CPU、GPU 和内存信号估算进程级别的能源消耗，而不是使用外部仪器测量墙插电源的能耗。 这为配置比较提供了统一的基础，但根据不同硬件平台上的空闲功耗情况，这可能导致更大的不确定性。

paragraphs.en: A further construct-validity consideration concerns the post-processing used to extract predictions from LLM outputs. Since LLMs generate free-form natural language responses, each task required a task-specific parser or extraction procedure to map the generated text to the expected evaluation format (e.g., labels, code, or structured log templates). To mitigate this issue, our prompts explicitly instructed the models to produce responses in predefined structured formats. Nevertheless, adherence to these formats varied across models, reflecting differences in response style and instruction-following behavior. Deviations from the expected format occurred in some cases, particularly in multi-agent configurations where the final output resulted from multiple intermediate reasoning steps. Although the post-processing rules were applied consistently across all configurations for a given task, alternative extraction strategies or more robust output normalization could yield different measured accuracy, particularly when a response deviated from the expected format while still conveying the correct semantic answer. Consequently, the reported accuracy reflects both the underlying model performance and the effectiveness of the response extraction procedure adopted in this study.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个与结构效度相关的考量因素，涉及从大型语言模型（LLM）输出中提取预测结果所采用的后处理过程。 由于大型语言模型会生成自由形式的自然语言回应，因此每个任务都需要特定的解析器或提取程序，将生成的文本映射到预期的评估格式（例如标签、代码或结构化日志模板）。 为缓解这一问题，我们的提示明确指示模型以预定义的结构化格式生成回应。 然而，不同模型对这些格式的遵循程度存在差异，这反映了其回应风格和指令执行行为的区别。 在某些情况下，出现了偏离预期格式的情况，尤其是在多智能体配置中，最终输出是多个中间推理步骤的结果。 尽管对于特定任务，所有配置都一致应用了相同的后处理规则，但采用不同的提取策略或更稳健的输出标准化方法，可能会得出不同的准确率测量结果，尤其是在回应偏离预期格式但仍传达了正确语义答案的情况下。 因此，所报告的准确率既反映了底层模型的性能，也体现了本研究采用的回应提取程序的有效性。

paragraphs.en: This paper evaluated the effectiveness, energy consumption, and latency of agentic LLM configurations across five software engineering tasks, six LLMs, three hardware platforms, and two prompt strategies. The results show that increasing agentic complexity does not provide a general accuracy benefit. The multi-agent configuration improves average accuracy for vulnerability detection, but NA or SA is sufficient, and often strongest, for the other tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 本文评估了智能体式大语言模型配置在五个软件工程任务、六种大语言模型、三种硬件平台和两种提示策略中的有效性、能耗和延迟。 结果表明，增加智能体的复杂性并不会带来普遍的提升准确性的效果。 多智能体配置能够提高漏洞检测的平均准确性，但对于其他任务而言，NA 或 SA 配置已足够，且通常表现最强。

sents.en: This paper evaluated the effectiveness, energy consumption, and latency of agentic LLM configurations across five software engineering tasks, six LLMs, three hardware platforms, and two prompt strategies.
sents.zh: 本文评估了智能体式大语言模型配置在五个软件工程任务、六种大语言模型、三种硬件平台和两种提示策略中的有效性、能耗和延迟。

sents.en: The results show that increasing agentic complexity does not provide a general accuracy benefit.
sents.zh: 结果表明，增加智能体的复杂性并不会带来普遍的提升准确性的效果。

sents.en: The multi-agent configuration improves average accuracy for vulnerability detection, but NA or SA is sufficient, and often strongest, for the other tasks.
sents.zh: 多智能体配置能够提高漏洞检测的平均准确性，但对于其他任务而言，NA 或 SA 配置已足够，且通常表现最强。

paragraphs.en: The sustainability cost of additional agents is much more systematic. Averaged across tasks, models, prompts, and hardware platforms, MA consumes 6.36 × \times as much energy and runs 6.07 × \times as long as NA, while appearing in only one of the 66 Pareto-optimal configurations. Energy and latency are also tightly coupled ( r = 0.987 r=0.987 in log–log space), which means that inefficient configurations are usually both more energy-intensive and slower. Across the full experimental campaign, the runs consumed 651.7 kWh and corresponded to 110.8 kg CO 2 e under the fixed carbon-intensity assumption used in the study.
paragraphs.zh: 增加智能体所带来的可持续性成本更具系统性。 在任务、模型、提示词和硬件平台上的平均值显示，MA 消耗的能量是 NA 的 6.36 × \times，运行时间也是 NA 的 6.07 × \times，而它仅出现在 66 种帕累托最优配置中的一种。 能量和延迟也紧密相关（在对数-对数空间中 r = 0.987 r=0.987），这意味着低效的配置通常同时更耗能且速度更慢。 在整个实验过程中，运行共消耗了 651.7 kWh 能源，并根据研究中使用的固定碳强度假设，对应产生了 110.8 kg CO₂e 的排放。

sents.en: The sustainability cost of additional agents is much more systematic.
sents.zh: 增加智能体所带来的可持续性成本更具系统性。

paragraphs.en: The main practical implication is that sustainable agentic LLM system design should start from a lightweight baseline and escalate only when a task-specific benefit is measured. Model and prompt selection often matter more than adding agents: model choice varies sharply by task, and few-shot prompting is especially important for structured-output tasks such as log parsing. Future evaluations of agentic software engineering systems should therefore report accuracy together with energy and latency, so that claimed improvements can be assessed as full cost–benefit trade-offs rather than accuracy gains in isolation. Beyond evaluation methodology, future work should investigate alternative role assignments and coordination strategies within multi-agent configurations to determine whether more task-specialized designs can shift the Pareto frontier without proportionally increasing energy and latency costs. Future work will also extend the evaluation to repository-scale and tool-augmented software engineering tasks, additional model families, and production deployment environments to assess the generalizability of the observed trade-offs. We will further investigate adaptive orchestration policies that activate additional agents only when task uncertainty or expected accuracy gains justify the energy and latency overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 主要实际意义在于，可持续的智能体式大语言模型系统的设计应从轻量级基线开始，只有在衡量到特定任务收益时再进行升级。 模型和提示词的选择通常比添加智能体更为重要：模型选择因任务而异，而少样本提示对于结构化输出任务（如日志解析）尤为重要。 因此，未来对智能体式软件工程系统的评估应同时报告准确率、能耗和延迟，以便能够以完整的成本–收益权衡来评估所声称的改进，而非孤立地看待准确率提升。 除了评估方法外，未来工作还应研究多智能体配置中的替代角色分配与协调策略，以确定更专注于特定任务的设计是否能在不比例增加能耗和延迟成本的情况下改变帕累托前沿。 未来工作还将将评估扩展至仓库级和工具增强的软件工程任务、更多模型家族以及生产部署环境，以检验所观察到的权衡关系的泛化能力。 我们将进一步研究自适应编排策略，仅在任务不确定性或预期准确率提升足以证明其能耗和延迟开销时激活额外的智能体。
